jobs.title: Gas, Power & Emissions (GPE) Shift Operator
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies has developed strong expertise across oil and biofuels, natural gas, electricity and low-carbon energies. Our trading activities are conducted from our main international hubs, including Geneva, Paris, Houston and Singapore. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies for gas, LNG, power and low-carbon energies. Operating in highly dynamic and volatile markets, TGP plays a key role in supporting the Group's ambitions through the optimisation and management of complex energy portfolios. Based within our Gas, Power & Emissions (GPE) Operations team, you will support the management of TotalEnergies' physical gas and power portfolios across Europe. The team operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, ensuring the safe and efficient management of physical positions across European pipeline and transmission networks. The position is therefore organised on a shift basis, including nights, weekends and public holidays. Working in a fast-paced trading environment, you will interact closely with Gas, Power and LNG Trading Desks, Group affiliates, upstream and downstream teams, network operators and external counterparties. Activities: As a GPE Shift Operator, you will directly support the Gas and Power Trading Desks and contribute to the operational and commercial management of the Group's physical portfolio. Your main responsibilities will include:
• Manage physical gas and power positions across UK and Continental European markets.
• Maintain continuous communication with Gas, Power and LNG Trading Desks, Group affiliates, offshore field operators, procurement teams and external counterparties.
• Accurately and promptly nominate physical positions to transporters, transmission system operators and other relevant market participants using dedicated systems.
• Monitor operational data flows together with intraday and day-ahead market movements.
• Manage and balance the portfolio by responding to changes in supply and demand and instructions from the relevant trading and procurement desks.
• Commercially optimise physical positions outside standard office hours, including through electronic energy exchanges and OTC transactions, under the direction of the relevant Trading Desks.
• Manage upstream gas portfolios and portfolios for entities for which TotalEnergies acts as shipping agent, including the preparation of balancing reports.
• Ensure that entry and exit capacity requirements are appropriately managed.
• Liaise with counterparties regarding retrospective physical gas transactions where required.
• Review allocation data against nominated quantities, identify discrepancies and coordinate their resolution.
• Contribute proactively to business developments and identify opportunities to improve operational and commercial performance.
• Ensure that all activities comply with applicable pipeline and grid operator rules, market regulations, industry codes and internal procedures.
• Contribute to minimising financial penalties and operational exposure across the markets in which the team operates. You will operate across major UK and European trading hubs, interconnectors, storage facilities, LNG terminals, offshore fields, power plants and refineries. The role provides significant exposure to energy trading activities and acts as a key interface between Trading, Operations, Procurement, Back Office, Finance and Legal teams. Candidate Profile:
• You hold a university degree, ideally in Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Science or another relevant quantitative discipline.
• You have at least 1 year of relevant industry experience, ideally within gas and/or power operations, energy trading, scheduling, dispatching or a comparable position.
• You have strong numerical and analytical skills and are comfortable working with large volumes of data.
• You are fluent in English. Additional European languages would be an advantage.
• You are resilient and able to make accurate decisions quickly and confidently in a fast-moving environment.
• You are flexible and comfortable working within a 24/7 shift organisation, including nights, weekends and public holidays.
• You enjoy working collaboratively and communicating with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
• You demonstrate strong attention to detail together with sound commercial judgement.
• You have strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. At TotalEnergies, we believe that our employees' fulfilment comes from the diversity of experiences and opportunities available to them. We are committed to diversity and inclusion and to providing equal employment opportunities to all candidates.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies ha sviluppato una forte esperienza tra petrolio e biocarburanti, gas naturale, energia elettrica e basse emissioni di carbonio. Le nostre attività di trading sono condotte dai nostri principali hub internazionali, tra cui Ginevra, Parigi, Houston e Singapore. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) è il braccio di trading di TotalEnergies per gas, LNG, energia e basse emissioni di carbonio. Operando in mercati altamente dinamici e volatili, TGP svolge un ruolo chiave nel sostenere le ambizioni del Gruppo attraverso l'ottimizzazione e la gestione di complessi portafogli energetici. Con sede nel nostro team di operazioni Gas, Power & Emissions (GPE), supporterai la gestione dei portafogli di energia e gas fisici di TotalEnergies in tutta Europa. Il team opera 24 ore al giorno, 7 giorni alla settimana, garantendo la gestione sicura ed efficiente delle posizioni fisiche attraverso le reti europee di pipeline e trasmissione. La posizione è quindi organizzata a turni, incluse notti, fine settimana e festivi. Lavorando in un ambiente di trading veloce, si interagirà a stretto contatto con Gas, Power e LNG Trading Desk, Gruppo affiliati, team a monte e a valle, operatori di rete e controparti esterne. Attività: In qualità di GPE Shift Operator, supporterai direttamente i Gas and Power Trading Desk e contribuirai alla gestione operativa e commerciale del portafoglio fisico del Gruppo. Le tue principali responsabilità includono:
• Gestisci le posizioni fisiche del gas e della potenza nei mercati del Regno Unito e dell'Europa continentale.
• Mantenere la comunicazione continua con Gas, Power e GNL Trading Desk, Gruppo affiliati, operatori di campo offshore, team di approvvigionamento e controparti esterne.
• Accuratamente e prontamente nominare le posizioni fisiche ai trasportatori, agli operatori del sistema di trasmissione e ad altri partecipanti rilevanti del mercato utilizzando sistemi dedicati.
• Monitorare i flussi di dati operativi insieme ai movimenti di mercato intraday e day-ahead.
• Gestire e bilanciare il portafoglio rispondendo alle modifiche dell'offerta e della domanda e alle istruzioni dei relativi banchi di trading e degli appalti.
• Ottimizzare commercialmente posizioni fisiche al di fuori delle normali ore di ufficio, anche attraverso scambi di energia elettronica e transazioni OTC, sotto la direzione dei relativi Trading Desk.
• Gestisci portafogli e portafogli di gas a monte per le entità per le quali TotalEnergies agisce come agente di spedizione, compresa la preparazione dei rapporti di bilanciamento.
• Assicurarsi che i requisiti di entrata e uscita siano adeguatamente gestiti.
• Liaise con le controparti per quanto riguarda retrospettiva transazioni di gas fisico, ove richiesto.
• Rivedere i dati di allocazione contro le quantità nominate, identificare le discrepanze e coordinare la loro risoluzione.
• Contribuire proattivamente agli sviluppi aziendali e identificare le opportunità per migliorare le prestazioni operative e commerciali.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le attività rispettino le regole applicabili del gestore di pipeline e griglia, le normative di mercato, i codici del settore e le procedure interne.
• Contribuire a minimizzare le sanzioni finanziarie e l'esposizione operativa sui mercati in cui il team opera. Potrai operare attraverso principali hub di trading del Regno Unito e europeo, interconnessioni, strutture di storage, terminali LNG, campi offshore, centrali elettriche e raffinerie. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione significativa alle attività di trading energetico e funge da interfaccia chiave tra Trading, Operations, Procurement, Back Office, Finance e Legal team. Profilo del candidato:
• Hai una laurea, idealmente in Matematica, Economia, Ingegneria, Scienza o un'altra disciplina quantitativa rilevante.
• Hai almeno 1 anno di esperienza nel settore, idealmente all'interno delle operazioni di gas e/o di potenza, di trading energetico, di pianificazione, dispacciamento o una posizione paragonabile.
• Hai forti capacità numeriche e analitiche e sono confortevoli lavorando con grandi volumi di dati.
• Sei fluente in inglese. Altre lingue europee sarebbero un vantaggio.
• Siete resilienti e in grado di prendere decisioni accurate in modo rapido e sicuro in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.
• Sei flessibile e confortevole a lavorare all'interno di un'organizzazione di turni 24/7, tra cui notti, fine settimana e festivi.
• Ti piace lavorare in collaborazione e comunicare con una vasta gamma di stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Si dimostra forte attenzione ai dettagli insieme a un giudizio commerciale sano.
• Hai forti capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione.
• Sei esperto in Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel. In TotalEnergies, crediamo che la soddisfazione dei nostri dipendenti derivi dalla diversità di esperienze e opportunità a loro disposizione. Siamo impegnati nella diversità e nell'inclusione e nel fornire pari opportunità di lavoro a tutti i candidati.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kontext & Umwelt: TotalEnergies hat eine starke Expertise in den Bereichen Öl und Biokraftstoffe, Erdgas, Strom und kohlenstoffarme Energien entwickelt. Unsere Handelsaktivitäten werden von unseren wichtigsten internationalen Hubs aus durchgeführt, darunter Genf, Paris, Houston und Singapur. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) ist der Handelszweig von TotalEnergies für Gas, LNG, Strom und kohlenstoffarme Energien. TGP ist in hochdynamischen und volatilen Märkten tätig und spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Unterstützung der Ambitionen der Gruppe durch die Optimierung und Verwaltung komplexer Energieportfolios. Mit Sitz in unserem Gas, Power & Emissions (GPE) Operations Team unterstützen Sie das Management der physischen Gas- und Stromportfolios von TotalEnergies in ganz Europa. Das Team arbeitet 24 Stunden am Tag, 7 Tage die Woche und gewährleistet die sichere und effiziente Verwaltung der physischen Positionen in europäischen Pipeline- und Übertragungsnetzen. Die Position ist daher auf Schichtbasis organisiert, einschließlich Nächten, Wochenenden und Feiertagen. In einem schnelllebigen Handelsumfeld interagieren Sie eng mit Gas, Power und LNG Trading Desks, Konzerngesellschaften, vor- und nachgelagerten Teams, Netzwerkbetreibern und externen Gegenparteien. Aktivitäten: Als GPE Shift Operator unterstützen Sie direkt die Gas and Power Trading Desks und tragen zum operativen und kommerziellen Management des physischen Portfolios der Gruppe bei. Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
• Verwalten Sie physische Gas- und Strompositionen in Großbritannien und Kontinentaleuropa.
• Pflegen Sie die kontinuierliche Kommunikation mit Gas, Power und LNG Trading Desks, Konzerngesellschaften, Offshore-Feldbetreibern, Beschaffungsteams und externen Gegenparteien.
• genaue und unverzügliche Benennung physischer Positionen für Transportunternehmen, Fernleitungsnetzbetreiber und andere relevante Marktteilnehmer, die spezielle Systeme verwenden.
• Überwachung der operativen Datenflüsse zusammen mit Intraday- und Day-Ahead-Marktbewegungen.
• Verwalten und balancieren Sie das Portfolio, indem Sie auf Angebots- und Nachfrageänderungen reagieren und Anweisungen von den zuständigen Handels- und Beschaffungsstellen erhalten.
• Optimieren Sie die physischen Positionen außerhalb der üblichen Bürozeiten kommerziell, einschließlich durch elektronischen Energieaustausch und OTC-Transaktionen, unter der Leitung der entsprechenden Trading Desks.
• Verwaltung vorgelagerter Gasportfolios und Portfolios für Unternehmen, für die TotalEnergies als Schifffahrtsagent tätig ist, einschließlich der Erstellung von Bilanzberichten.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Anforderungen an die Ein- und Ausspeisekapazität angemessen verwaltet werden.
• Kontaktaufnahme mit den Geschäftspartnern bei retrospektiven physischen Gastransaktionen, sofern erforderlich.
• Überprüfung der Zuteilungsdaten anhand der angegebenen Mengen, Ermittlung von Abweichungen und Koordinierung ihrer Auflösung.
• Tragen Sie proaktiv zu Geschäftsentwicklungen bei und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der operativen und kommerziellen Leistung.
• Gewährleistung, dass alle Tätigkeiten den geltenden Vorschriften für Pipeline- und Netzbetreiber, Marktvorschriften, Branchenkodizes und internen Verfahren entsprechen.
• Beitrag zur Minimierung finanzieller Sanktionen und operationeller Risiken in den Märkten, in denen das Team tätig ist. Sie werden in wichtigen britischen und europäischen Handelszentren, Interkonnektoren, Speicheranlagen, LNG-Terminals, Offshore-Feldern, Kraftwerken und Raffinerien tätig sein. Die Rolle bietet eine erhebliche Exposition gegenüber Energiehandelsaktivitäten und fungiert als eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Trading, Operations, Procurement, Back Office, Finance und Legal Teams. Bewerberprofil:
• Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss, idealerweise in Mathematik, Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Naturwissenschaften oder einer anderen relevanten quantitativen Disziplin.
• Sie verfügen über mindestens 1 Jahr einschlägige Branchenerfahrung, idealerweise in den Bereichen Gas- und / oder Strombetrieb, Energiehandel, Terminplanung, Versand oder eine vergleichbare Position.
• Sie verfügen über starke numerische und analytische Fähigkeiten und arbeiten gerne mit großen Datenmengen.
• Sie sprechen fließend Englisch. Weitere europäische Sprachen wären von Vorteil.
• Sie sind belastbar und in der Lage, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung schnell und sicher genaue Entscheidungen zu treffen.
• Sie arbeiten flexibel und komfortabel in einer 24/7 Schichtorganisation, einschließlich Nächten, Wochenenden und Feiertagen.
• Sie arbeiten gerne mit einer breiten Palette von internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen und kommunizieren.
• Sie zeigen starke Liebe zum Detail zusammen mit einem soliden kommerziellen Urteil.
• Sie haben starke zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
• Sie beherrschen Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel. Bei TotalEnergies glauben wir, dass die Erfüllung unserer Mitarbeiter aus der Vielfalt der ihnen zur Verfügung stehenden Erfahrungen und Möglichkeiten resultiert. Wir setzen uns für Vielfalt und Inklusion ein und bieten allen Kandidaten gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Contexte & Environnement: TotalEnergies a développé une solide expertise dans le secteur du pétrole et des biocarburants, du gaz naturel, de l'électricité et des énergies à faible intensité de carbone. Nos activités commerciales sont menées à partir de nos principaux centres internationaux, dont Genève, Paris, Houston et Singapour. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) est le bras de négociation de TotalEnergies pour le gaz, le GNL, l'énergie et les énergies à faible intensité de carbone. Opérant sur des marchés très dynamiques et volatils, TGP joue un rôle clé pour soutenir les ambitions du Groupe par l'optimisation et la gestion de portefeuilles énergétiques complexes. Basé sur notre équipe d'exploitation Gaz, Puissance et Émissions (GPE), vous soutiendrez la gestion des portefeuilles de gaz et d'énergie physiques de TotalEnergies dans toute l'Europe. L'équipe fonctionne 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, assurant une gestion sûre et efficace des positions physiques sur les réseaux européens de pipeline et de transport. La position est donc organisée par équipe, y compris les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Travaillant dans un environnement de trading rapide, vous interagirez étroitement avec les bureaux de trading du gaz, de l'électricité et du GNL, les filiales du Groupe, les équipes en amont et en aval, les opérateurs de réseau et les contreparties externes. Activités : En tant qu'opérateur de poste GPE, vous soutiendrez directement les comptoirs de commerce du gaz et de l'électricité et contribuerez à la gestion opérationnelle et commerciale du portefeuille physique du Groupe. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :
• Gérer les positions du gaz et de l'électricité sur les marchés britanniques et continentaux européens.
• Maintenir une communication continue avec les comptoirs de négociation du gaz, de l'électricité et du GNL, les filiales du Groupe, les exploitants de terrain offshore, les équipes d'approvisionnement et les contreparties externes.
• Désigner avec précision et promptitude des postes physiques aux transporteurs, aux gestionnaires de réseau de transport et aux autres acteurs concernés du marché utilisant des systèmes spécialisés.
• Surveiller les flux de données opérationnelles ainsi que les mouvements intrajournaliers et quotidiens du marché.
• Gérer et équilibrer le portefeuille en répondant à l'évolution de l'offre et de la demande et aux instructions des comptoirs de négociation et d'approvisionnement concernés.
• Optimiser commercialement les positions physiques en dehors des heures de bureau standard, y compris par le biais des échanges électroniques d'énergie et des transactions de gré à gré, sous la direction des comptoirs commerciaux concernés.
• Gérer les portefeuilles et les portefeuilles de gaz en amont pour les entités pour lesquelles TotalEnergies agit en tant qu'agent maritime, y compris la préparation de rapports d'équilibrage.
• Veiller à ce que les besoins en matière de capacité d'entrée et de sortie soient adéquatement gérés.
• Assurer la liaison avec les contreparties en ce qui concerne les transactions rétrospectives sur gaz physique, le cas échéant.
• Examiner les données relatives à l'allocation en fonction des quantités proposées, identifier les écarts et coordonner leur résolution.
• Contribuer de façon proactive à l'évolution des affaires et cerner les possibilités d'améliorer le rendement opérationnel et commercial.
• Veiller à ce que toutes les activités soient conformes aux règles applicables aux exploitants de pipelines et de réseaux de distribution, aux règlements de marché, aux codes de l'industrie et aux procédures internes.
• Contribuer à minimiser les pénalités financières et l'exposition opérationnelle sur les marchés dans lesquels l'équipe opère. Vous opérerez à travers les grands pôles commerciaux britanniques et européens, les interconnexions, les installations de stockage, les terminaux GNL, les champs offshore, les centrales électriques et les raffineries. Ce rôle offre une exposition importante aux activités de commerce de l'énergie et constitue une interface clé entre les équipes de commerce, d'exploitation, d'approvisionnement, de back office, de finances et de services juridiques. Profil du candidat :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire, idéalement en mathématiques, économie, ingénierie, sciences ou une autre discipline quantitative pertinente.
• Vous avez au moins 1 an d'expérience dans l'industrie, idéalement dans les opérations de gaz et/ou d'électricité, le commerce de l'énergie, l'horaire, l'expédition ou une position comparable.
• Vous avez de solides compétences numériques et analytiques et êtes à l'aise de travailler avec de grands volumes de données.
• Vous parlez couramment l'anglais. D'autres langues européennes seraient un avantage.
• Vous êtes résilient et capable de prendre des décisions précises rapidement et avec confiance dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
• Vous êtes flexible et confortable dans une organisation de travail 24/7, y compris les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés.
• Vous aimez travailler en collaboration et communiquer avec un large éventail d'intervenants internes et externes.
• Vous faites preuve d'une grande attention aux détails et d'un bon jugement commercial.
• Vous avez de solides compétences interpersonnelles et de communication.
• Vous maîtrisez Microsoft Office, en particulier Excel. Chez TotalEnergies, nous croyons que l'épanouissement de nos employés provient de la diversité des expériences et des possibilités qui leur sont offertes. Nous sommes déterminés à promouvoir la diversité et l'inclusion et à offrir des possibilités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.

jobs.title: Assets Trader – Power & Gas (Europe)
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low-carbon energies. With more than 550 employees, TGP operates in Switzerland, the United States, Singapore, France, Germany and Spain. It evolves in fast-changing market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation. TGP is responsible for optimizing the purchase and sales portfolios of gas, electricity, CO ₂ emissions, dry bulk and LNG across global markets, in compliance with the Company’s trading guidelines. Within TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP), the Power Assets Trading Desk is a key growth component of the European Power Trading activity. Asset Trading is one of 4 Power trading desks, working in very close coordination with other power, gas, marketing and structured trading teams. European trading activities are managed from Geneva and span Power, Gas, Emissions, and related commodities. The desk mission is to maximize the value of a large and diversified portfolio of flexible generation assets and procurement contracts across seven European markets. Working closely with internal stakeholders and asset owners, the team combines fundamental market analysis, market intelligence, and active trading across power, gas, and emissions markets to capture value and support the growth of the Company's energy business. Leveraging a strong balance sheet and a disciplined risk framework, the desk can warehouse risk, express directional market views, and capitalize on market opportunities across multiple time horizons. You will join a high-performing team of five professionals with significant commercial ambitions and a strong track record. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing optimization and trading strategies across both short- and long-term horizons, working closely with Operations, Origination, Asset Management, and other trading desks. We are looking for a commercially driven individual with a proven ability to formulate and implement well-reasoned market views. You combine strong analytical skills with intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a relentless focus on value creation. You thrive in complex and fast-moving environments, consistently seeking opportunities to enhance portfolio performance while navigating operational constraints and market liquidity considerations. Your experience enables you to translate market insights into executable strategies and deliver results in a highly competitive trading environment. The portfolio is diversified and rapidly expanding, TotalEnergies is now top-3 gas generation in Europe. As the scale and complexity of the business continue to grow, the role offers significant opportunities to contribute to increasingly sophisticated optimization and trading strategies while helping shape the future of the Company's European energy activities. Activities: Market expertise * Develop an in-depth understanding of European power markets, including market design, price formation, generation stack dynamics and across market segments * Maintain strong awareness of gas and emissions markets and their interactions with power * Monitor capacity mechanisms and ancillary services where relevant * Formulate and express market views to generate value beyond intrinsic asset optimisation, including discretionary positioning Asset expertise * Build a detailed technical understanding of the asset portfolio * Determine optimal dispatch strategies considering operational constraints, cost sand market conditions Modelling & tools * Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of analytical and modelling tools * Support the digitalisation of workflows and real-time risk management capabilities * Work closely with Research, Digital and IT teams Trading strategy & execution * Define and implement trading and hedging strategies aligned with market conditions and asset constraints * Execute trades across power, gas and emissions markets within defined mandates * Contribute to portfolio balancing, risk management and overall trading performance Commercial & cross-functional interaction * Work with Origination and project teams to support new agreements and portfolio growth * Liaise with Operations and asset owners on short-term optimisation and dispatch decisions * Interact with diverse functions (Finance, Middle Office, Back Office, IT, Research) as required Compliance * Ensure full compliance with internal policies and external regulations, including REMIT Accountabilities * Operate within the Company’s trading governance and risk framework * Contribute to the performance of the desk, with both collective responsibility and individual impact * Ensure adherence to HSE rules, Code of Conduct and applicable regulations You will operate in a highly dynamic and volatile market environment, shaped by evolving energy flows, regulatory developments and the energy transition. This role offers exposure to a diversified and growing portfolio of flexible generation assets, requiring close interaction between trading, operations and commercial teams. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile:
• Degree in Engineering, Finance or equivalent study that enables you to work with large data sets.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Contesto & Ambiente: Data di inizio desiderata: Q1 2027 TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) è il braccio di trading di TotalEnergies nel campo delle energie a basso tenore di carbonio. Con oltre 550 dipendenti, TGP opera in Svizzera, Stati Uniti, Singapore, Francia, Germania e Spagna. Si evolve in dinamiche di mercato in rapida evoluzione influenzate da fattori interni ed esterni che richiedono un adattamento costante. TGP è responsabile dell’ottimizzazione dei portafogli di acquisto e vendita di gas, elettricità, emissioni di CO 2, rinfuse secche e LNG sui mercati globali, nel rispetto delle linee guida di trading della Società. Stai cercando di crescere la tua carriera in un ambiente di trading dinamico e internazionale? Ti piace lavorare con i numeri, collaborare tra le squadre e fornire un lavoro di alta qualità in un ambiente veloce? Stiamo cercando qualcuno che sia proattivo, adattabile e confortevole a lavorare verso le scadenze di segnalazione. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team di finanza e gli affiliati di Trading internazionali, sviluppando una forte comprensione del business e contribuendo alle attività di pianificazione e budgeting chiave. Attività: Reporting mensile di gestione
• Consolida e analizza i dati finanziari degli affiliati di Power Trading, concentrandosi su KPI chiave come margine lordo e reddito operativo netto.
• Supporti il Power Trading Country Reporting e garantisci un report finanziario tempestivo e accurato da parte di affiliati.
• Si prepara la segnalazione mensile a costi fissi, tra cui accruamenti, pagamenti anticipati e analisi delle variazioni di bilancio.
• L'utente supporta la raccolta e la segnalazione dei costi di abbonamento dei dati attraverso il perimetro TGP. Piano a lungo termine
• Si assiste al coordinamento del processo di previsione annuale 5/8 anni su Power Trading affiliati (Geneva, Houston, Parigi, Düsseldorf & Singapore).
• Si esaminano le previsioni P&L e capital impiegate per garantire l'accuratezza e l'allineamento con i presupposti strategici del Gruppo.
• Prepara analisi, grafici e presentazioni per TGP e Group Senior Management. Bilancio
• Sostiene un processo simile al Piano di Lungo Termine, incentrato sulle previsioni dell’anno in corso e sul bilancio iniziale dell’anno successivo, con particolare attenzione al conteggio e ai costi fissi
• Si coordina con HR, business unit e affiliati per consolidare i dati. Siamo impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze energetiche di una popolazione in crescita e ci impegniamo alla transizione energetica. La volatilità dei mercati del trading energetico richiede l'eccellenza nella gestione dei rischi e una cultura dell'innovazione. Stiamo abbracciando pienamente la rivoluzione digitale. I nostri popoli fioriscono in un ambiente che promuove competenze, spirito di imprenditorialità, agilità e una cultura mirata, generando opportunità sconfinate per imparare, crescere e raggiungere il successo collaborativo. Rafforzare le competenze del nostro popolo è un pilastro fondamentale della nostra cultura: formiamo il nostro popolo per garantire il loro sviluppo e ci impegniamo a incoraggiare la sicurezza in tutte le nostre azioni. Cerchiamo passione, ambizione e mentalità aperta. Mentre ci evolgiamo in un settore esigente che richiede di essere sempre al limite, coltiviamo un luogo di lavoro amichevole dove la nostra gente si sente bene, dove lo spirito di squadra e il rispetto guidano la nostra routine quotidiana, dove la diversità della nostra gente e le loro abilità creano un'esperienza nutriente per tutti noi. Profilo del candidato:
• Il candidato ideale detiene un master o sta attualmente studiando verso un master in Contabilità, Finanza, Business Administration, o un campo relativo.
• Una certa esperienza nella contabilità di gestione o nell'analisi finanziaria sarebbe un bene.
• Forte competenze IT e gestione dei dati, con competenza in Excel, Word e PowerPoint; la conoscenza di SAGE e SAP è un plus.
• Forte capacità di modellazione numerica e foglio di calcolo, con un alto livello di precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità organizzative, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente sotto pressione e rispettare scadenze strette.
• La fluidità in inglese e francese è essenziale.
• Un accordo tripartito è obbligatorio* * Importante: Si prega di notare che, conformemente alle normative svizzere, i candidati devono fornire un accordo di tirocinio tripartito rilasciato dalla loro università per poter beneficiare di questo stage. Purtroppo, le domande senza un valido accordo tripartito rilasciato dall'università non possono essere considerate. Si prega di verificare questo con la vostra università prima di applicare.

Kontext & Umwelt: Gewünschtes Startdatum: Q1 2027 TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) ist der Handelszweig von TotalEnergies im Bereich kohlenstoffarmer Energien. Mit mehr als 550 Mitarbeitern ist TGP in der Schweiz, den USA, Singapur, Frankreich, Deutschland und Spanien tätig. Es entwickelt sich in einer sich schnell verändernden Marktdynamik, die von internen und externen Faktoren beeinflusst wird, die eine ständige Anpassung erfordern. TGP ist verantwortlich für die Optimierung der Einkaufs- und Verkaufsportfolios von Gas, Strom, CO2-Emissionen, Massengut und LNG auf den globalen Märkten in Übereinstimmung mit den Handelsrichtlinien des Unternehmens. Möchten Sie Ihre Karriere in einem dynamischen und internationalen Handelsumfeld ausbauen? Haben Sie Spaß daran, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten, teamübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten und qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld zu leisten? Wir suchen jemanden, der proaktiv, anpassungsfähig und komfortabel arbeitet, um fristen zu melden. Sie werden eng mit Finanzteams und internationalen Handelsunternehmen zusammenarbeiten, während Sie ein starkes Verständnis des Geschäfts entwickeln und zu wichtigen Planungs- und Budgetierungsaktivitäten beitragen. Aktivitäten: Monatliches Management Reporting
• Sie konsolidieren und analysieren Finanzdaten von Power Trading-Tochtergesellschaften und konzentrieren sich dabei auf wichtige KPIs wie Bruttomarge und Nettobetriebsergebnis.
• Sie unterstützen Power Trading Country Reporting und stellen eine zeitnahe und genaue Finanzberichterstattung von Affiliates sicher.
• Sie erstellen monatliche Fixkostenberichte, einschließlich Rückstellungen, Vorauszahlungen und Budgetvarianzanalysen.
• Sie unterstützen die Erhebung und Berichterstattung von Datenabonnementkosten über den TGP-Perimeter. Langfristiger Plan
• Sie unterstützen Sie bei der Koordination des jährlichen 5/8-Jahres-Prognoseprozesses zwischen Power Trading-Tochtergesellschaften (Genf, Houston, Paris, Düsseldorf & Singapur).
• Sie überprüfen die Prognosen für P&L und eingesetztes Kapital, um Genauigkeit und Übereinstimmung mit den Annahmen der Konzernstrategie sicherzustellen.
• Sie erstellen Analysen, Grafiken und Präsentationen für TGP und Group Senior Management. Haushalt
• Sie unterstützen einen Prozess ähnlich dem Long-Term Plan, der sich auf die aktuelle Jahresprognose und das erste Budget des folgenden Jahres mit besonderem Fokus auf Mitarbeiterzahl und Fixkosten konzentriert
• Sie koordinieren sich mit HR, Business Units und Affiliates, um Daten zu konsolidieren. jobs.title: Quant Modeling Analyst - Oil
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Desired Start Date : January 2027 Take your first steps into a fulfilling career and join our Front Innovation Team as a quantitative analyst. Are you looking to grow your career in the vibrant world of energy trading? Do you have an engineering or quantitative finance background with good programming skills? If yes, we would love to see your profile! To support TotalEnergies’s ambitions, the Front Innovation Tools team (FIT) is looking to hire their next quantitative analyst. Want to learn more about the Front Innovation Tools (FIT) team? Watch this short video * from Damien to gain additional insights into the team's mission, working environment and key areas of activity: *Please note that any additional videos, testimonials or supporting materials are shared to provide general context about our teams and work environment. The official description of the position is outlined in this job posting. TotalEnergies has developed a strong expertise in oil, biofuels, natural gas and electricity trading. Trading entities are based in Geneva, Paris, Dubai, Athens, Houston and Singapore. TotalEnergies installed its European trading hub across in Geneva, which now bring together very large teams around trading activities: TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T&S) and TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). Activities: You will be part of the FIT team, a team of 9 members, sitting on the trading floor. The FIT team is responsible for the development and delivery of models and digital tools for the Oil and Gas trading desks. It is the entry point for all trading desks, whether they are physical or paper and works closely with the market analysis, risk departments and IT. FIT team is part of a global department encompassing all market analysis and modelling on power, gas and oil markets. The topics, FIT team covers are the following:
• Option pricing models . Use the adequate volatility models to be able to price all type of options available on the financial markets. Work on fitting models and regularly update the central system with the market values.
• Structuring . Provide adequate financial products together with marketing based on clients’ needs. Analyse the risks of various payoffs. Detect optionalities in physical assets or physical transactions.
• Dashboarding . Provide traders with visual tools that enable them to synthesize their risk, view live market prices and/or simulate their position.
• Credit risk monitoring . Measure the potential risk taken when trading derivatives instruments with counterparts with which there is no CSA agreement. Measure the return on risk taken with these counterparts.
• Logistics Optimisation . Blending tools, automatic update of tank levels, cargo simulation.
• CICD . Continuous maintenance of our IT Ecosystem. Mastery of deployment tools, work in coordination with Cyber, Infra … The tools developed by the team are used daily by traders and maintained by FIT. A strong understanding of our architecture, a genuine interest in IT topics and a commitment to users’ needs are essential to succeed in the team. FIT works closely with the DDIT department and with a dedicated DDIT-FO team. Key IT challenges for the coming year include integrating AI agents into online tools and addressing cybersecurity requirements. The main programming languages used are Python, C++ and VBA. Depending on users’ needs, the tools delivered to traders range from Excel spreadsheets to complex web applications. The trading floor is a high pace, challenging environment, requiring agility, sharpness and rigour. Good communication, teamwork, multi-tasking are also essential skills. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. TotalEnergies a développé une solide expertise dans le commerce du pétrole, des biocarburants, du gaz naturel et de l'électricité. Activités: Vous ferez partie de l'équipe FIT, une équipe de 9 membres, assise sur le plancher de négociation. L'équipe du FIT est responsable de l'élaboration et de la livraison de modèles et d'outils numériques pour les comptoirs de commerce du pétrole et du gaz. C'est le point d'entrée de tous les bureaux de négociation, qu'ils soient physiques ou papier, et qu'ils travaillent en étroite collaboration avec l'analyse du marché, les services des risques et les TI. • Structurer . Fournir des produits financiers adéquats ainsi que du marketing en fonction des besoins des clients. Analyser les risques liés aux divers avantages. Détecter les options dans les biens matériels ou les transactions physiques.
• Tableau de bord . Fournir aux traders des outils visuels qui leur permettent de synthétiser leur risque, de visualiser les prix du marché en direct et/ou de simuler leur position.
• Surveillance des risques de crédit . Mesurer le risque potentiel pris lors de la négociation d'instruments dérivés avec des contreparties avec lesquelles il n'existe pas d'accord CSA. Mesurer le rendement du risque pris avec ces homologues.
• Optimisation logistique . Outils de mélange, mise à jour automatique des niveaux des citernes, simulation du fret.
• CICD . Entretien continu de notre écosystème informatique. Maîtrise des outils de déploiement, travail en coordination avec Cyber, Infra ... Une bonne communication, le travail d'équipe, le multitâche sont également des compétences essentielles. La volatilité des marchés du commerce de l'énergie exige l'excellence dans la gestion des risques et une culture de l'innovation. Nous acceptons pleinement la révolution numérique. Nos gens prospèrent dans un environnement qui favorise l'expertise, l'esprit d'entreprise, l'agilité et une culture axée sur l'objectif, générant des possibilités illimitées d'apprendre, de grandir et de réussir en collaboration. Renforcer les compétences de notre peuple est un pilier clé de notre culture : nous formons notre peuple à assurer son développement et nous nous engageons à encourager la sécurité dans toutes nos actions. Nous recherchons passion, ambition et ouverture d'esprit. Alors que nous évoluons dans une industrie exigeante qui demande à être toujours à la pointe, nous cultivons un milieu de travail amical où nos gens se sentent bien, où l'esprit d'équipe et le respect guident notre routine quotidienne, où la diversité de nos gens et leurs compétences créent une expérience nourrissante pour nous tous. Profil du candidat :

Il titolare della posizione lavora all'interno del dipartimento Market Risk Transformation e interagisce con tutta l'organizzazione di trading. L'ambiente di trading veloce richiede al titolare del lavoro di poter lavorare autonomamente e all'interno del team. La posizione richiede l'interazione quotidiana con altri dipartimenti all'interno dell'organizzazione in particolare Front Office, Operations, Market Risk Funzioni, Finanza, Compliance e IT. Sono stati rispettati i regolamenti, l'industria e le scadenze contrattuali, che richiedono una buona capacità di pianificare e lavorare sotto pressione temporale. Attività: Data di inizio 01/10/2026 Il titolare del lavoro lavora all'interno di una funzione Market Risk e deve essere in grado di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente dinamico e aperto. Principali attività:
• Sostenere l'avanzamento del rilevamento di anomalia nell'ETRM utilizzando strumenti interni disponibili o sviluppando algoritmi per verificare l'accuratezza delle transazioni inserite nell'ETRM, utilizzando scambi storici e dati di mercato come riferimenti
• Assicurare la documentazione e le metodologie del progetto sono completamente formalizzate, mantenute e aggiornate
• Possedere, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni di codebase esistenti, garantendo la loro continuità, scalabilità e supporto a lungo termine. esperienza pratica che si sviluppa con LLM (ad esempio Claude, ingegneria rapida, codifica assistita da AI) richiesto
• Contribuisci alla progettazione e distribuzione di soluzioni di automazione e AI per Market Risk, individuando opportunità innovative per migliorare l'efficienza del progetto e rafforzare i processi storici di controllo del rischio
• Assistere il team nell'analisi e nel reporting eventi di Rischio Operativo e eseguire analisi di cause forensi e radice
• Supportato la standardizzazione delle soluzioni AI, accelerando l'adozione di business e la scalabilità Dimensione del lavoro:
• Assistere i team nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento degli strumenti di processo aziendale integrando le funzionalità AI ogni volta che necessario
• Analizzare gli eventi del Rischio Operativo per identificare cause e driver di rischio
• Sostenere l'attuazione di misure di mitigazione per prevenire errori o frodi sulle transazioni fisiche e finanziarie
• Promuovere una cultura di parlare, trasparenza e gestione dei rischi all'interno dell'organizzazione Scopo:
• Responsabile per lo sviluppo di Proof of Concept Tools & Algorithm che supporta la trasformazione del rischio di mercato
• Gestione accurata e tempestiva di tutti i progetti e delle rispettive scadenze
• Promuovere l'approccio al rischio operativo, la trasparenza e la gestione dei rischi all'interno dell'organizzazione
• Contribuisci a ridurre i rischi di perdita legati alle operazioni di trading sfruttando i miglioramenti dei processi
• Comunicazione efficace con numerosi dipartimenti sulla gestione dei cambiamenti
• Dimostrare una forte autonomia e solide capacità di comunicazione
• Laurea in Matematica, Ingegneria, Scienza informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo commerciale relativo
• Esperienza dimostrata nello sviluppo dell'algoritmo di analisi dei dati
• Forte capacità analitiche, con competenza nelle lingue di codifica (domande di pitone) e esperienza iniziale nello sviluppo di strumenti basati su AI
• Contesto tecnico: Trattamento dati, Python, LLMs, Claude Code, Databricks
• L'accordo tripartito è obbligatorio Siamo impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze energetiche di una popolazione in crescita e ci impegniamo alla transizione energetica. La volatilità dei mercati del trading energetico richiede l'eccellenza nella gestione dei rischi e una cultura dell'innovazione. Stiamo abbracciando pienamente la rivoluzione digitale. I nostri popoli fioriscono in un ambiente che promuove competenze, spirito di imprenditorialità, agilità e una cultura mirata, generando opportunità sconfinate per imparare, crescere e raggiungere il successo collaborativo. Rafforzare le competenze del nostro popolo è un pilastro fondamentale della nostra cultura: formiamo il nostro popolo per garantire il loro sviluppo e ci impegniamo a incoraggiare la sicurezza in tutte le nostre azioni. Cerchiamo passione, ambizione e mentalità aperta. Mentre ci evolgiamo in un settore esigente che richiede di essere sempre al limite, coltiviamo un luogo di lavoro amichevole dove la nostra gente si sente bene, dove lo spirito di squadra e il rispetto guidano la nostra routine quotidiana, dove la diversità della nostra gente e le loro abilità creano un'esperienza nutriente per tutti noi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies trading entities (TTE) are responsible for the development and the management of a portfolio of commercial outlets for oil and oil products, natural gas, natural gas liquids, shale gas, liquefied natural gas, power, emissions certificates, and dry bulk products in Europe, the United States and Asia. The position holder works within the Market Risk Transformation department and interacts with all the trading organization. The fast-paced trading environment requires the jobholder to be able to work autonomously and within the team. Position requires daily interaction with other departments within the organization notably Front Office, Operations, Market Risk functions, Finance, Compliance and IT. Attention to be given to Regulations, Industry and contractual deadlines have been respected, requiring good ability to plan and work under time pressure. Activities: Start date 01/10/2026 The jobholder works within a Market Risk function and must be able to work effectively in a dynamic and open environment . Main activities:
• Support the advancement of anomaly detection in the ETRM by utilizing available internal tools or developing algorithms to verify the accuracy of transactions entered in the ETRM, using historical trades and market data as references
• Ensure project documentation and methodologies are fully formalized, maintained, and kept up to date
• Own, maintain, and enhance existing codebases solutions, ensuring their continuity, scalability, and long-term support. hands-on experience developing with LLMs (e.g. Claude, prompt engineering, AI-assisted coding) required
• Contribute to the design and deployment of automation and AI solutions for Market Risk, identifying innovative opportunities to enhance project efficiency and strengthen historical risk control processes
• Assist the team in analysing and reporting Operational Risk events and perform forensic and root cause analysis
• Supported the standardization of AI solutions, accelerating business adoption and scalability Job dimension:
• Assist teams in developing and enhancing business process tools by integrating AI capabilities whenever relevant
• Analyse the Operational Risk events to identify root causes and risk drivers
• Support the implementation of mitigation measures to prevent errors or fraud on physical and financial transactions
• Promote a culture of speaking up, transparency and risk management within the organisation Purpose:
• Responsible for the development of Proof of Concept Tools & Algorithm supporting Market Risk Transformation
• Accurate and timely management of all projects and their respective deadlines
• Promote the Operational risk approach, transparency and risk management within the organization
• Contribute to reducing risks of loss linked to trading operations by leveraging process improvements
• Effective communication with numerous departments on change management
• Demonstrate strong autonomy and solid communication skills Candidate Profile:
• Undergraduate degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related Business field
• Proven experience in data analysis algorithm development
• Strong analytical capabilities, with proficiency in coding languages (python mandatory) and initial experience in developing AI‑driven tools
• Technical context: Data processing, Python, LLMs, Claude Code, Databricks
• Tripartite agreement is mandatory We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Kontext & Umwelt: TotalEnergies Handelseinheiten (TTE) sind verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und das Management eines Portfolios von kommerziellen Verkaufsstellen für Öl und Ölprodukte, Erdgas, Erdgasflüssigkeiten, Schiefergas, Flüssigerdgas, Strom, Emissionszertifikate und Massengüter in Europa, den Vereinigten Staaten und Asien. Der Positionsinhaber arbeitet in der Abteilung Marktrisikotransformation und interagiert mit allen Handelsorganisationen. Das schnelllebige Handelsumfeld erfordert, dass der Jobinhaber autonom und im Team arbeiten kann. Position erfordert die tägliche Interaktion mit anderen Abteilungen innerhalb der Organisation, insbesondere Front Office, Operations, Marktrisikofunktionen, Finanzen, Compliance und IT. Verordnungen, Industrie- und Vertragsfristen wurden eingehalten, was eine gute Planungs- und Arbeitsfähigkeit unter Zeitdruck erfordert. Aktivitäten: Startdatum 01/10/2026 Der Jobinhaber arbeitet innerhalb einer Marktrisikofunktion und muss in der Lage sein, in einem dynamischen und offenen Umfeld effektiv zu arbeiten. Haupttätigkeiten:
• Unterstützung der Weiterentwicklung der Anomalieerkennung im ETRM durch die Verwendung verfügbarer interner Tools oder die Entwicklung von Algorithmen zur Überprüfung der Genauigkeit der in das ETRM eingegebenen Transaktionen unter Verwendung historischer Handels- und Marktdaten als Referenzen
• Sicherstellen, dass die Projektdokumentation und -methoden vollständig formalisiert, gepflegt und auf dem neuesten Stand gehalten werden
• Besitzen, pflegen und verbessern Sie bestehende Codebasenlösungen, um deren Kontinuität, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Support zu gewährleisten. Praxiserfahrung mit LLMs (z.B. Claude, prompt engineering, AI-assisted coding) erforderlich
• Beitrag zur Gestaltung und Bereitstellung von Automatisierungs- und KI-Lösungen für Marktrisiken, Identifizierung innovativer Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Projekteffizienz und Stärkung historischer Risikokontrollprozesse
• Unterstützen Sie das Team bei der Analyse und Berichterstattung von Operational Risk-Ereignissen und führen Sie eine forensische und Ursachenanalyse durch
• Unterstützte die Standardisierung von KI-Lösungen, beschleunigte Geschäftsannahme und Skalierbarkeit Job-Dimension:
• Unterstützung von Teams bei der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Business-Prozess-Tools durch die Integration von KI-Fähigkeiten, wann immer relevant
• Analysieren Sie die operationellen Risikoereignisse, um Ursachen und Risikotreiber zu identifizieren
• Unterstützung der Umsetzung von Minderungsmaßnahmen zur Vermeidung von Fehlern oder Betrug bei physischen und finanziellen Transaktionen
• Förderung einer Kultur des Sprechens, der Transparenz und des Risikomanagements innerhalb der Organisation Zweck:
• Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung von Proof of Concept Tools & Algorithmus zur Unterstützung der Marktrisikotransformation
• Präzise und zeitnahe Verwaltung aller Projekte und deren jeweilige Fristen
• Förderung des Ansatzes für operationelle Risiken, Transparenz und Risikomanagement innerhalb der Organisation
• Beitrag zur Verringerung der Verlustrisiken im Zusammenhang mit Handelsoperationen durch die Nutzung von Prozessverbesserungen
• Effektive Kommunikation mit zahlreichen Abteilungen zum Change Management
• Demonstrieren Sie starke Autonomie und solide Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Kandidatenprofil:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder einem verwandten Geschäftsfeld
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Datenanalysealgorithmen
• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit Kenntnissen in Programmiersprachen (Python obligatorisch) und ersten Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung von KI-gestützten Tools
• Technischer Kontext: Datenverarbeitung, Python, LLMs, Claude Code, Databricks
• Dreiseitige Vereinbarung ist verpflichtend Wir verpflichten uns, den Energiebedarf einer wachsenden Bevölkerung zu decken, und wir engagieren uns für die Energiewende. Die Volatilität der Energiehandelsmärkte erfordert hervorragendes Risikomanagement und eine Innovationskultur. Wir nehmen die digitale Revolution voll und ganz auf. Unsere Mitarbeiter gedeihen in einem Umfeld, das Fachwissen, Unternehmergeist, Agilität und eine zielgerichtete Kultur fördert und grenzenlose Möglichkeiten zum Lernen, Wachsen und gemeinsamen Erfolg schafft. Die Stärkung der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeiter ist eine wichtige Säule unserer Kultur: Wir schulen unsere Mitarbeiter, um ihre Entwicklung zu gewährleisten, und wir verpflichten uns, die Sicherheit in all unseren Handlungen zu fördern. Wir suchen Leidenschaft, Ehrgeiz und Offenheit. Während wir uns in einer anspruchsvollen Branche entwickeln, die immer am Rande sein möchte, pflegen wir einen freundlichen Arbeitsplatz, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeiter gut fühlen, in dem Teamgeist und Respekt unseren Alltag leiten, in dem die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiter und ihre Fähigkeiten eine nährende Erfahrung für uns alle schaffen.

• Promouvoir l'approche des risques opérationnels, la transparence et la gestion des risques au sein de l'organisation

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Your next challenge starts in Geneva! Interested in the commercial and strategic side of energy trading? Curious about how new markets are assessed, business opportunities are developed and investment decisions are made? Join our New Ventures team within the Power Trading division in Geneva and contribute to the expansion of our power trading activities across Europe and the Asia-Pacific region. Working in an international and fast-moving environment, you will gain direct exposure to market-entry strategies, business development, financial analysis and potentially M&A transactions, supporting projects that shape the future of our power trading business. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low-carbon energies. With more than 550 employees, TGP operates in Switzerland, the United States, Singapore, France, Germany and Spain. It evolves in fast-changing market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation. TGP is responsible for optimizing the purchase and sales portfolios of gas, electricity, CO ₂ emissions, dry bulk and LNG across global markets, in compliance with the Company’s trading guidelines. Activities: As a Power Trading – New Ventures & Business Development Intern, you will contribute to strategic projects supporting the international development of our power trading activities. Working closely with trading desks, regulatory experts, market analysts, Legal and other business teams, your responsibilities will include: Business Development & New Market Entry
• Support the assessment of new business opportunities and potential market entries across Europe and the Asia-Pacific region.
• Contribute to the development of business plans, including market assessments, financial assumptions and commercial scenarios.
• Work with trading desks, regulatory specialists and support functions to assess market attractiveness, opportunities and implementation requirements.
• Prepare analyses and presentations to support management decisions on new market entry. Market Intelligence & Strategic Analysis
• Conduct market research to identify potential partners, key stakeholders and emerging commercial opportunities.
• Monitor competitor activities, market structures and regulatory developments in targeted markets.
• Analyze electricity market trends, including renewable penetration, supply and demand dynamics, and interactions with natural gas and LNG markets.
• Translate qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for the business. Long-Term Planning & Business Forecasting
• Support the preparation of business plans and financial forecasts for power trading activities.
• Collaborate with trading desks and relevant teams, including corporate PPAs, Renewables and Flexible Power, to develop commercial assumptions and business projections.
• Contribute to financial models, scenario analyses and budgeting exercises.
• Prepare management presentations and supporting materials for strategic discussions. Mergers & Acquisitions and Strategic Partnerships Depending on the team's active transaction pipeline:
• Support the assessment of potential acquisitions, investments and strategic partnerships in the power trading sector.
• Collaborate with the Corporate M&A team on business analysis and due diligence activities.
• Review information memoranda and documentation made available through transaction data rooms.
• Contribute to due diligence Q&A processes and prepare analysis for internal management committees. Throughout the internship, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of defined workstreams, interact with senior stakeholders and explore how digital tools and Generative AI can support research, market analysis and business development. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile:
• Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
• Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, combined with sound commercial judgment. Financial modelling skills would be a strong advantage.
• Ability to structure complex or ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
• Basic knowledge of energy markets and a genuine interest in power trading and business development.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex subjects clearly and concisely.
• Advanced proficiency in English, both written and spoken. French would be an advantage.
• Curious, proactive and resourceful, with a willingness to take initiative and contribute new ideas.
• Comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities and adapting to evolving projects.
• Interest in Generative AI and its practical applications in research and business analysis, with an understanding of the importance of verifying information, challenging outputs and documenting assumptions.
• A collaborative mindset and an organized, objective and solution-oriented approach.
• A tri-partite agreement is mandatory

descriptionByLocale.it:
Context & Environment: La tua prossima sfida inizia a Ginevra! Interessato al lato commerciale e strategico del trading energetico? Curioso su come vengono valutati i nuovi mercati, le opportunità di business sono sviluppate e le decisioni di investimento sono prese? Unisciti al nostro team di Nuove Venture all'interno della divisione Power Trading di Ginevra e contribuisci all'espansione delle nostre attività di trading di potenza in Europa e nella regione Asia-Pacifico. Lavorando in un ambiente internazionale e in rapida evoluzione, si acquisirà un'esposizione diretta alle strategie di market-entry, allo sviluppo aziendale, all'analisi finanziaria e alle transazioni potenzialmente M&A, sostenendo progetti che modellano il futuro del nostro business trading di potenza. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) è il braccio di trading di TotalEnergies nel campo delle energie a basso tenore di carbonio. Con oltre 550 dipendenti, TGP opera in Svizzera, Stati Uniti, Singapore, Francia, Germania e Spagna. Si evolve in dinamiche di mercato in rapida evoluzione influenzate da fattori interni ed esterni che richiedono un adattamento costante. TGP è responsabile dell’ottimizzazione dei portafogli di acquisto e vendita di gas, elettricità, emissioni di CO 2, rinfuse secche e LNG sui mercati globali, nel rispetto delle linee guida di trading della Società. Attività: Come Power Trading – New Ventures & Business Development Intern, contribuirai a progetti strategici che sostengono lo sviluppo internazionale delle nostre attività di trading di potere. Lavorando a stretto contatto con banchi di trading, esperti di regolamentazione, analisti di mercato, team legali e di altre imprese, le tue responsabilità includono: Business Development & New Market Entry
• Sostenere la valutazione di nuove opportunità di business e potenziali entrate di mercato in Europa e nella regione Asia-Pacifico.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo di piani aziendali, comprese le valutazioni di mercato, le ipotesi finanziarie e gli scenari commerciali.
• Lavora con banchi di trading, specialisti di regolamentazione e funzioni di supporto per valutare l'attrattiva del mercato, le opportunità e i requisiti di attuazione.
• Preparare analisi e presentazioni per sostenere le decisioni di gestione sul nuovo mercato. Intelligenza del mercato e analisi strategica
• Condurre la ricerca di mercato per identificare potenziali partner, stakeholder chiave e opportunità commerciali emergenti.
• Monitorare le attività concorrenti, le strutture di mercato e gli sviluppi normativi nei mercati mirati.
• Analizzare le tendenze del mercato dell'elettricità, tra cui la penetrazione rinnovabile, la dinamica dell'offerta e della domanda, e le interazioni con i mercati del gas naturale e del LNG.
• Traduci risultati qualitativi e quantitativi in chiare raccomandazioni per il business. Pianificazione a lungo termine & previsione aziendale
• Sostenere la preparazione di piani aziendali e previsioni finanziarie per le attività di trading di energia.
• Collabora con banchi di trading e team rilevanti, tra cui PPAs aziendale, Rinnovabili e Potere Flessibile, per sviluppare presupposti commerciali e proiezioni aziendali.
• Contribuire a modelli finanziari, analisi scenari ed esercizi di budgeting.
• Preparare presentazioni di gestione e materiali di supporto per discussioni strategiche. Fusioni e acquisizioni e partenariati strategici A seconda della pipeline operativa del team:
• Sostenere la valutazione di potenziali acquisizioni, investimenti e partnership strategiche nel settore del trading di potenza.
• Collabora con il team Corporate M&A per l'analisi aziendale e le attività di due diligence.
• Revisione delle informazioni memoranda e documentazione resa disponibile attraverso le sale dati delle transazioni.
• Contribuire a due processi di diligenza Q&A e preparare l'analisi per i comitati di gestione interna. In tutto lo stage, avrai l'opportunità di prendere la proprietà di flussi di lavoro definiti, interagire con gli stakeholder senior e esplorare come strumenti digitali e AI Generativo possono supportare la ricerca, l'analisi del mercato e lo sviluppo aziendale. Siamo impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze energetiche di una popolazione in crescita e ci impegniamo alla transizione energetica. La volatilità dei mercati del trading energetico richiede l'eccellenza nella gestione dei rischi e una cultura dell'innovazione. Stiamo abbracciando pienamente la rivoluzione digitale. I nostri popoli fioriscono in un ambiente che promuove competenze, spirito di imprenditorialità, agilità e una cultura mirata, generando opportunità sconfinate per imparare, crescere e raggiungere il successo collaborativo. Rafforzare le competenze del nostro popolo è un pilastro fondamentale della nostra cultura: formiamo il nostro popolo per garantire il loro sviluppo e ci impegniamo a incoraggiare la sicurezza in tutte le nostre azioni. Cerchiamo passione, ambizione e mentalità aperta. Mentre ci evolgiamo in un settore esigente che richiede di essere sempre al limite, coltiviamo un luogo di lavoro amichevole dove la nostra gente si sente bene, dove lo spirito di squadra e il rispetto guidano la nostra routine quotidiana, dove la diversità della nostra gente e le loro abilità creano un'esperienza nutriente per tutti noi. Profilo del candidato:
• Attualmente perseguire un Master in Ingegneria, Business, Finanza, Economia o una disciplina relativa.
• Forte capacità analitiche e quantitative, combinate con un giudizio commerciale sano. Le capacità di modellazione finanziaria sarebbero un forte vantaggio.
• Capacità di strutturare problemi complessi o ambigui, sviluppare ipotesi e tradurre analisi in raccomandazioni pratiche.
• Conoscenza di base dei mercati dell'energia e un autentico interesse per il trading di energia e lo sviluppo aziendale.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, con la capacità di spiegare soggetti complessi chiaramente e concisamente.
• Conoscenza avanzata in inglese, sia scritta che parlata. Il francese sarebbe un vantaggio.
• Curioso, proattivo e ricco di risorse, con la volontà di prendere iniziativa e contribuire nuove idee.
• Confortevole lavoro indipendente, gestione delle priorità concorrenti e adattamento a progetti in evoluzione.
• L'interesse per l'intelligenza genetica e le sue applicazioni pratiche nella ricerca e nell'analisi aziendale, con la comprensione dell'importanza di verificare le informazioni, sfidare le uscite e documentare le ipotesi.
• Una mentalità collaborativa e un approccio organizzato, obiettivo e orientato alla soluzione.
• Un accordo tripartito è obbligatorio

Context & Environment: Your next challenge starts in Geneva! Interested in the commercial and strategic side of energy trading? Curious about how new markets are assessed, business opportunities are developed and investment decisions are made? Join our New Ventures team within the Power Trading division in Geneva and contribute to the expansion of our power trading activities across Europe and the Asia-Pacific region. Working in an international and fast-moving environment, you will gain direct exposure to market-entry strategies, business development, financial analysis and potentially M&A transactions, supporting projects that shape the future of our power trading business. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low-carbon energies. With more than 550 employees, TGP operates in Switzerland, the United States, Singapore, France, Germany and Spain. It evolves in fast-changing market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation. TGP is responsible for optimizing the purchase and sales portfolios of gas, electricity, CO ₂ emissions, dry bulk and LNG across global markets, in compliance with the Company’s trading guidelines. Activities: As a Power Trading – New Ventures & Business Development Intern, you will contribute to strategic projects supporting the international development of our power trading activities. Working closely with trading desks, regulatory experts, market analysts, Legal and other business teams, your responsibilities will include: Business Development & New Market Entry
• Support the assessment of new business opportunities and potential market entries across Europe and the Asia-Pacific region.
• Contribute to the development of business plans, including market assessments, financial assumptions and commercial scenarios.
• Work with trading desks, regulatory specialists and support functions to assess market attractiveness, opportunities and implementation requirements.
• Prepare analyses and presentations to support management decisions on new market entry. Market Intelligence & Strategic Analysis
• Conduct market research to identify potential partners, key stakeholders and emerging commercial opportunities.
• Monitor competitor activities, market structures and regulatory developments in targeted markets.
• Analyze electricity market trends, including renewable penetration, supply and demand dynamics, and interactions with natural gas and LNG markets.
• Translate qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for the business. Long-Term Planning & Business Forecasting
• Support the preparation of business plans and financial forecasts for power trading activities.
• Collaborate with trading desks and relevant teams, including corporate PPAs, Renewables and Flexible Power, to develop commercial assumptions and business projections.
• Contribute to financial models, scenario analyses and budgeting exercises.
• Prepare management presentations and supporting materials for strategic discussions. Mergers & Acquisitions and Strategic Partnerships Depending on the team's active transaction pipeline:
• Support the assessment of potential acquisitions, investments and strategic partnerships in the power trading sector.
• Collaborate with the Corporate M&A team on business analysis and due diligence activities.
• Review information memoranda and documentation made available through transaction data rooms.
• Contribute to due diligence Q&A processes and prepare analysis for internal management committees. Throughout the internship, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of defined workstreams, interact with senior stakeholders and explore how digital tools and Generative AI can support research, market analysis and business development. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile:
• Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
• Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, combined with sound commercial judgment. Financial modelling skills would be a strong advantage.
• Ability to structure complex or ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
• Basic knowledge of energy markets and a genuine interest in power trading and business development.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex subjects clearly and concisely.
• Advanced proficiency in English, both written and spoken. French would be an advantage.
• Curious, proactive and resourceful, with a willingness to take initiative and contribute new ideas.
• Comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities and adapting to evolving projects.
• Interest in Generative AI and its practical applications in research and business analysis, with an understanding of the importance of verifying information, challenging outputs and documenting assumptions.
• A collaborative mindset and an organized, objective and solution-oriented approach.
• A tri-partite agreement is mandatory
