descriptionByLocale.fr:
Contexte & Environnement: Votre prochain défi commence à Genève! Intéressé par le volet commercial et stratégique du commerce de l'énergie? Curieusement, comment les nouveaux marchés sont évalués, les occasions d'affaires développées et les décisions d'investissement prises? Rejoignez notre équipe de New Ventures au sein de la division Power Trading à Genève et contribuez à l'expansion de nos activités de commerce d'électricité en Europe et dans la région Asie-Pacifique. En travaillant dans un environnement international et en évolution rapide, vous serez directement exposé aux stratégies d'entrée sur le marché, au développement des entreprises, à l'analyse financière et aux transactions de fusion et d'acquisition potentielles, appuyant des projets qui façonnent l'avenir de notre commerce d'électricité. TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) est le bras commercial de TotalEnergies dans le domaine des énergies à faible intensité de carbone. Avec plus de 550 employés, TGP opère en Suisse, aux États-Unis, à Singapour, en France, en Allemagne et en Espagne. Elle évolue dans une dynamique de marché en évolution rapide influencée par des facteurs internes et externes qui nécessitent une adaptation constante. TGP est responsable d'optimiser les portefeuilles d'achat et de vente de gaz, d'électricité, d'émissions de CO2, de vrac sec et de GNL sur les marchés mondiaux, conformément aux directives commerciales de la Société. Activités : En tant que stagiaire en commerce de l'électricité – Nouvelles entreprises et développement des entreprises, vous contribuerez à des projets stratégiques soutenant le développement international de nos activités de commerce de l'électricité. En étroite collaboration avec les bureaux commerciaux, les experts en réglementation, les analystes de marché, les équipes juridiques et autres, vos responsabilités comprendront : Développement des entreprises et Nouvelle entrée sur le marché
• Appuyer l'évaluation des nouvelles possibilités d'affaires et des débouchés potentiels en Europe et dans la région Asie-Pacifique.
• Contribuer à l'élaboration de plans d'affaires, y compris des évaluations du marché, des hypothèses financières et des scénarios commerciaux.
• Collaborer avec les comptoirs commerciaux, les spécialistes de la réglementation et les fonctions d'appui pour évaluer l'attrait du marché, les possibilités et les exigences de mise en oeuvre.
• Préparer des analyses et des présentations pour appuyer les décisions de gestion concernant l'entrée sur le marché. Intelligence du marché et analyse stratégique
• Mener des études de marché afin de déterminer les partenaires potentiels, les intervenants clés et les nouvelles possibilités commerciales.
• Surveiller les activités des concurrents, les structures du marché et l'évolution de la réglementation sur les marchés ciblés.
• Analyser les tendances du marché de l'électricité, y compris la pénétration des énergies renouvelables, la dynamique de l'offre et de la demande, et les interactions avec les marchés du gaz naturel et du GNL.
• Traduire les résultats qualitatifs et quantitatifs en recommandations claires pour l'entreprise. Planification à long terme et prévision des activités
• Appuyer l'élaboration de plans d'affaires et de prévisions financières pour les activités de commerce d'électricité.
• Collaborer avec les comptoirs de négociation et les équipes compétentes, y compris les AAE, les énergies renouvelables et l'électricité flexible, pour élaborer des hypothèses commerciales et des projections commerciales.
• Contribuer aux modèles financiers, aux analyses de scénarios et aux exercices de budgétisation.
• Préparer des présentations de la direction et du matériel d'appui pour les discussions stratégiques. Fusions et acquisitions et partenariats stratégiques Selon le pipeline de transaction actif de l'équipe :
• Appuyer l'évaluation des acquisitions potentielles, des investissements et des partenariats stratégiques dans le secteur du commerce de l'électricité.
• Collaborer avec l'équipe des fusions-acquisitions sur les activités d'analyse opérationnelle et de diligence raisonnable.
• Examiner les mémorandums d'information et la documentation disponibles dans les salles de données des transactions.
• Contribuer aux processus de vérification et d'évaluation de la diligence raisonnable et préparer l'analyse des comités de gestion internes. Tout au long du stage, vous aurez l'occasion de prendre en charge des flux de travail définis, d'interagir avec des intervenants seniors et d'explorer comment les outils numériques et l'IA Generative peuvent soutenir la recherche, l'analyse de marché et le développement des affaires. Nous sommes déterminés à répondre aux besoins énergétiques d'une population croissante et nous sommes engagés dans la transition énergétique. La volatilité des marchés du commerce de l'énergie exige l'excellence dans la gestion des risques et une culture de l'innovation. Nous acceptons pleinement la révolution numérique. Nos gens prospèrent dans un environnement qui favorise l'expertise, l'esprit d'entreprise, l'agilité et une culture axée sur l'objectif, générant des possibilités illimitées d'apprendre, de grandir et de réussir en collaboration. Renforcer les compétences de notre peuple est un pilier clé de notre culture : nous formons notre peuple à assurer son développement et nous nous engageons à encourager la sécurité dans toutes nos actions. Nous recherchons passion, ambition et ouverture d'esprit. Alors que nous évoluons dans une industrie exigeante qui demande à être toujours à la pointe, nous cultivons un milieu de travail amical où nos gens se sentent bien, où l'esprit d'équipe et le respect guident notre routine quotidienne, où la diversité de nos gens et leurs compétences créent une expérience nourrissante pour nous tous. Profil du candidat :
• Il est actuellement titulaire d'une maîtrise en génie, en affaires, en finances, en économie ou dans une discipline connexe.
• Fortes capacités analytiques et quantitatives, combinées à un bon jugement commercial. Les compétences en modélisation financière constitueraient un avantage important.
• Capacité de structurer des problèmes complexes ou ambigus, de développer des hypothèses et de traduire l'analyse en recommandations pratiques.
• Connaissance de base des marchés de l'énergie et intérêt véritable pour le commerce de l'électricité et le développement des entreprises.
• Forte capacité de communication et de présentation, avec la capacité d'expliquer des sujets complexes de façon claire et concise.
• Compétence avancée en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée. Le français serait un avantage.
• Curieux, proactif et débrouillard, avec une volonté de prendre des initiatives et de contribuer à de nouvelles idées.
• Un travail confortable et indépendant, la gestion des priorités concurrentes et l'adaptation à l'évolution des projets.
• Intérêt pour l'IA Generative et ses applications pratiques dans la recherche et l'analyse commerciale, en comprenant l'importance de vérifier l'information, de remettre en question les extrants et de documenter les hypothèses.
• Un état d'esprit collaboratif et une approche organisée, objective et orientée vers la solution.
• Un accord tripartite est obligatoire

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Your next challenge starts in Geneva! Behind every successful energy trade is a complex maritime operation. At TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping, our Shipping teams ensure that cargoes move safely, efficiently and reliably across global markets. We are looking for an experienced Shipping Operator with a seagoing background to join our Geneva team and play a central role in coordinating international maritime operations. Trading & Shipping (T&S) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies for crude oil, refined products, biofuels and paper derivatives. With around 1,000 employees, T&S operates from Geneva, Houston, Singapore, Dubai, Athens and Paris, ensuring the daily supply of refineries and distribution networks worldwide. In energy markets, T&S creates value through fair value assessment of flows, sourcing the best products for customers, and managing operational, financial, regulatory and HSE risks. As logistics and safety professionals, teams operate across the entire energy supply chain in fast-moving markets shaped by geopolitical and economic factors, requiring constant adaptation. Curious to discover more about the Shipping Operator profession? Watch this short video * for a glimpse into the profession and its working environment. *Please note that this video is intended to provide general context and does not represent the exact scope or responsibilities of the position advertised. Please refer to this job posting for the official description of the role. Activities: What you will do As a Shipping Operator, you will coordinate daily shipping operations and ensure the safe, efficient and compliant execution of voyages from pre-fixture to post-voyage. Your responsibilities will include:
• Coordinating and monitoring vessel operations across the full voyage lifecycle
• Acting as a key point of contact with shipowners, charterers, agents and internal stakeholders
• Working closely with Trading, Chartering, Technical, Vetting and other support functions
• Ensuring voyage execution in line with contractual terms, operational requirements and internal procedures
• Optimizing voyages for chartered vessels, taking into account safety, efficiency, timing and cost
• Monitoring operational performance, incidents, delays and associated costs
• Supporting risk management and ensuring compliance with HSE standards
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of operational processes and ways of working We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile: Mandatory requirement: A minimum of 3 years’ seagoing experience as an Officer on gas (LNG or LPG) or oil carriers. You will thrive in this role if you:
• Have solid experience in maritime operations, shipping or fleet management.
• Have a strong understanding of voyage operations and the maritime environment.
• Are familiar with shipping contracts, operational processes and voyage execution.
• Are rigorous, reactive and able to manage multiple priorities under time pressure.
• Have strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
• Communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Demonstrate team spirit, reliability and a strong sense of commitment.

In TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping, i nostri team di spedizione assicurano che i carichi si muovano in modo sicuro, efficiente e affidabile sui mercati globali. Stiamo cercando un operatore di trasporto esperto con un background di navigazione per unirsi al nostro team di Ginevra e svolgere un ruolo centrale nel coordinamento delle operazioni marittime internazionali. Trading & Shipping (T&S) è il braccio di trading di TotalEnergies per il petrolio grezzo, prodotti raffinati, biocarburanti e derivati della carta. Con circa 1.000 dipendenti, T&S opera da Ginevra, Houston, Singapore, Dubai, Atene e Parigi, garantendo la fornitura quotidiana di raffinerie e reti di distribuzione in tutto il mondo. Nei mercati dell'energia, T&S crea valore attraverso una valutazione del fair value dei flussi, alimentando i migliori prodotti per i clienti e gestendo i rischi operativi, finanziari, normativi e HSE. Come professionisti della logistica e della sicurezza, i team operano in tutta la catena di approvvigionamento energetico nei mercati in rapida evoluzione, modellati da fattori geopolitici ed economici, che richiedono un adattamento costante. Curioso per scoprire di più sulla professione di Operatore di Spedizione? Guarda questo breve video * per uno sguardo alla professione e al suo ambiente di lavoro. *Si prega di notare che questo video è destinato a fornire contesto generale e non rappresenta l'esatta portata o responsabilità della posizione pubblicizzata. Le tue responsabilità includono:

• Agire come punto chiave di contatto con armatori, noleggiatori, agenti e stakeholder interni

• Monitoraggio delle prestazioni operative, degli incidenti, dei ritardi e dei costi associati
• Sostenere la gestione dei rischi e garantire il rispetto degli standard HSE
• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi operativi e dei modi di lavoro Ci impegniamo a soddisfare le esigenze energetiche di una popolazione in crescita e ci impegniamo alla transizione energetica. La volatilità dei mercati del trading energetico richiede l'eccellenza nella gestione dei rischi e una cultura dell'innovazione. Stiamo abbracciando pienamente la rivoluzione digitale. Le nostre persone fioriscono in un ambiente che promuove competenze, spirito di imprenditorialità, agilità e una cultura mirata, generando opportunità sconfinate per imparare, crescere e raggiungere il successo collaborativo. Cerchiamo passione, ambizione e mentalità aperta. Mentre ci evolgiamo in un settore esigente che richiede di essere sempre al limite, coltiviamo un luogo di lavoro amichevole dove la nostra gente si sente bene, dove lo spirito di squadra e il rispetto guidano la nostra routine quotidiana, dove la diversità della nostra gente e le loro abilità creano un'esperienza nutriente per tutti noi. Profilo del candidato: Obbligatorio: Un’esperienza di navigazione minima di 3 anni come Ufficiale sul gas (LNG o GPL) o vettori petroliferi. Si prospererà in questo ruolo se:

• Avere una forte comprensione delle operazioni di viaggio e dell'ambiente marittimo.

• Avere forti capacità organizzative e un'ottima attenzione ai dettagli.

• Dimostrare spirito di squadra, affidabilità e un forte senso di impegno.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Context & Environment: Your next challenge starts in Geneva! Behind every successful energy trade is a complex maritime operation. At TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping, our Shipping teams ensure that cargoes move safely, efficiently and reliably across global markets. We are looking for an experienced Shipping Operator with a seagoing background to join our Geneva team and play a central role in coordinating international maritime operations. Trading & Shipping (T&S) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies for crude oil, refined products, biofuels and paper derivatives. With around 1,000 employees, T&S operates from Geneva, Houston, Singapore, Dubai, Athens and Paris, ensuring the daily supply of refineries and distribution networks worldwide. In energy markets, T&S creates value through fair value assessment of flows, sourcing the best products for customers, and managing operational, financial, regulatory and HSE risks. As logistics and safety professionals, teams operate across the entire energy supply chain in fast-moving markets shaped by geopolitical and economic factors, requiring constant adaptation. Curious to discover more about the Shipping Operator profession? Watch this short video * for a glimpse into the profession and its working environment. *Please note that this video is intended to provide general context and does not represent the exact scope or responsibilities of the position advertised. Please refer to this job posting for the official description of the role. Activities: What you will do As a Shipping Operator, you will coordinate daily shipping operations and ensure the safe, efficient and compliant execution of voyages from pre-fixture to post-voyage. Your responsibilities will include:
• Coordinating and monitoring vessel operations across the full voyage lifecycle
• Acting as a key point of contact with shipowners, charterers, agents and internal stakeholders
• Working closely with Trading, Chartering, Technical, Vetting and other support functions
• Ensuring voyage execution in line with contractual terms, operational requirements and internal procedures
• Optimizing voyages for chartered vessels, taking into account safety, efficiency, timing and cost
• Monitoring operational performance, incidents, delays and associated costs
• Supporting risk management and ensuring compliance with HSE standards
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of operational processes and ways of working We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile: Mandatory requirement: A minimum of 3 years’ seagoing experience as an Officer on gas (LNG or LPG) or oil carriers. You will thrive in this role if you:
• Have solid experience in maritime operations, shipping or fleet management.
• Have a strong understanding of voyage operations and the maritime environment.
• Are familiar with shipping contracts, operational processes and voyage execution.
• Are rigorous, reactive and able to manage multiple priorities under time pressure.
• Have strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
• Communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Demonstrate team spirit, reliability and a strong sense of commitment.

Context & Environment: Take your first steps into energy trading Love building software and curious about energy trading? Put your Python and full-stack skills to work on tools supporting gas and LNG risk teams. About Us TotalEnergies is an integrated multi-energy company with expertise in oil and biofuels, natural gas, electricity and low-carbon energies. Our Trading & Shipping and Gas & Power activities connect international energy markets with trading teams and support functions. Our Geneva hub brings together specialists working across physical and financial energy markets. Our Culture Energy markets move quickly, and so do our teams. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, collaboration and initiative. As an intern, you will learn from experienced professionals, contribute to real projects and work in a diverse, international environment where continuous development and respect are central to how we work. Activities: You will join a Market Risk / Middle Office environment supporting gas and LNG trading activities. This internship targets a hands-on software developer interested in building solutions for analytical and operational users in a financial-markets setting. The role combines software engineering with exposure to trading and risk-management stakeholders. Your Responsibilities
• Contribute to the development and improvement of software tools used in the Middle Office environment.
• Work with business and technical stakeholders to translate user needs into practical software solutions.
• Apply modern development practices and maintain robust, readable code.
• Explore opportunities to use databases, web applications and cloud services in internal tools. Candidate Profile:
• Currently completing a Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related technical field.
• Hands-on full-stack development experience and genuine enthusiasm for coding.
• Strong Python and Git skills are mandatory.
• Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases; experience with React and Streamlit.
• Understanding of AWS cloud services and cloud-native architectures.
• Strong analytical skills, autonomy and effective collaboration; interest in financial markets, trading or risk management is a plus.
• A tri-partite agreement is mandatory

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies Gas and Power is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low carbon energies (mainly gas, LNG and power). As such it operates in fast-evolving market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation and evolution. Uncertainties specific to the trading environment (volatility of prices, supply & demand mismatches) are coupled with those coming from the broader energy sector (climate change policies, changes in the energy mix, developments of new energy sources, etc). In such context Trading helps to ensure growth and profitability to a key segment of the business in order to reach TotalEnergies long term objectives in terms of extracting value from its Integrated Power strategy. Activities:
• Provide daily written reports to European Trading Power teams, including Front Desks, ‘Pricing & Risk Management’ teams and Senior Management, as well as to Paris headquarters, affiliates and market partners.
• Create, update and give presentations on market-related topics.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of reports automation and industrialisation when possible, with the help of Analyst, Quantitative Modelers and IT teams.
• Monitor availability of new data sources and tools to expand the current reach of the team’s analytics.
• Extracts meaningful insights from European fundamental models and fundamental data in collaboration with other analysts (generation, demand, flows, weather impact, etc) and contribute to the market watch on market structure in terms of companies, infrastructure and regulations.
• Support traders defining trading strategies.
• Lead discussions with trading desks and/or senior management.
• Collaborate with the other regional analysts to build cross-commodity/cross-geography analytics and forecasts, with quantitative analysts and data scientists within the team to leverage advanced analytical techniques
• Conduct ad hoc analysis and projects in support of other analysts, traders, and senior management. Candidate Profile: Start date: 01/10/2026
• Ongoing studies in Economics, Business or Engineering.
• Knowledge of the European power and emissions market, power systems dispatch and flows dynamics and/or understanding of operations.
• Excellent skills with the Microsoft Office suite (Power Point, Excel…).
• Skilly in Python programming and Databricks are welcome.
• Good analytical skills, ability to transform large amounts of information into a few key insights.
• Working experience within a trading environment is welcome;
• Familiarity with visualization frameworks (PowerBI/etc.) are welcome.
• Fluent in English (oral and written) – knowledge of French and/or other languages is an advantage
• The position requires autonomy, objectivity, innovation, to be resourceful and well organized;
• The ideal candidate should be able to explain complex issues and present them in a clear and concise manner. Accountabilities
• Provide in-depth analysis to identify current and future drivers and behaviours of the European power and emissions markets.
• Provide a proactive advisory view of the European power and emissions market to the relevant desks and to the management
• Help build and communicate a global view of energy markets, enhance the Company’s understanding of energy markets interactions
• Promote TGP trading activities to market partners and counterparts via reports, meetings and intervention at external meetings and conferences

descriptionByLocale.it:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies Gas and Power è il braccio di trading di TotalEnergies nel campo delle basse energie di carbonio (principalmente gas, LNG e potenza). In quanto tale opera in dinamiche di mercato in rapida evoluzione influenzate da fattori interni ed esterni che richiedono un costante adattamento ed evoluzione. Le incertezze specifiche per l'ambiente di trading (la volatilità dei prezzi, l'offerta e la domanda di errori) sono accoppiate con quelle provenienti dal settore energetico più ampio (politiche di cambiamento climatico, cambiamenti nel mix energetico, sviluppi di nuove fonti energetiche, ecc). In tale contesto Trading aiuta a garantire la crescita e la redditività di un segmento chiave del business al fine di raggiungere obiettivi a lungo termine TotalEnergies in termini di estrazione del valore dalla sua strategia di Integrated Power. Attività:
• Fornire relazioni scritte giornaliere ai team europei di Trading Power, tra cui Front Desks, team di “Pricing & Risk Management” e Senior Management, così come alla sede di Parigi, affiliati e partner di mercato.
• Creare, aggiornare e dare presentazioni su argomenti legati al mercato.
• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle relazioni di automazione e industrializzazione quando possibile, con l'aiuto di Analyst, Quantitative Modelers e team IT.
• Monitorare la disponibilità di nuove fonti di dati e strumenti per espandere la portata corrente dell’analisi del team.
• Estrae intuizioni significative da modelli fondamentali europei e dati fondamentali in collaborazione con altri analisti (generazione, domanda, flussi, impatto meteorologico, ecc) e contribuiscono alla vigilanza di mercato sulla struttura di mercato in termini di aziende, infrastrutture e regolamenti.
• Supporta i trader che definiscono le strategie di trading.
• Condurre discussioni con banchi di trading e/o senior management.
• Collabora con gli altri analisti regionali per la costruzione di analisi e previsioni cross-comodity/cross-geography, con analisti quantitativi e scienziati di dati all'interno del team per sfruttare le tecniche analitiche avanzate
• Condurre analisi ad hoc e progetti a sostegno di altri analisti, commercianti e senior management. Profilo del candidato: Data di inizio: 01/10/2026
• Studi in corso in Economia, Business o Ingegneria.
• Conoscenza del mercato europeo della potenza e delle emissioni, dei sistemi di alimentazione e dei flussi di dinamica e/o comprensione delle operazioni.
• Competenze eccellenti con la suite Microsoft Office (Power Point, Excel...).
• Skilly nella programmazione Python e Databricks sono i benvenuti.
• Buone capacità analitiche, capacità di trasformare grandi quantità di informazioni in alcune intuizioni chiave.
• L'esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un ambiente di trading è gradita;
• La familiarità con i quadri di visualizzazione (PowerBI/etc.) sono i benvenuti.
• Fluente in inglese (orale e scritto) – la conoscenza del francese e/o di altre lingue è un vantaggio
• La posizione richiede l'autonomia, l'oggettività, l'innovazione, per essere ricca e ben organizzata;
• Il candidato ideale dovrebbe essere in grado di spiegare problemi complessi e presentarli in modo chiaro e conciso. Capacità di contabilità
• Fornisci un'analisi approfondita per identificare i driver e i comportamenti attuali e futuri dei mercati europei di potenza e di emissioni.
• Fornire una visione consultiva proattiva del mercato europeo dell'energia e delle emissioni agli uffici competenti e alla gestione
• Aiuta a costruire e comunicare una visione globale dei mercati dell’energia, migliorare la comprensione della Società delle interazioni dei mercati dell’energia
• Promuovere le attività di trading TGP verso partner di mercato e controparti attraverso rapporti, riunioni e interventi in riunioni e conferenze esterne

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kontext & Umwelt: TotalEnergies Gas and Power ist der Handelszweig von TotalEnergies im Bereich der kohlenstoffarmen Energien (hauptsächlich Gas, LNG und Strom). Als solches ist es in einer sich schnell entwickelnden Marktdynamik tätig, die von internen und externen Faktoren beeinflusst wird, die eine ständige Anpassung und Entwicklung erfordern. Spezifische Unsicherheiten im Handelsumfeld (Preisvolatilität, Diskrepanzen zwischen Angebot und Nachfrage) sind mit Unsicherheiten aus dem breiteren Energiesektor verbunden (Klimawandelpolitik, Veränderungen im Energiemix, Entwicklung neuer Energiequellen usw.). In diesem Zusammenhang trägt der Handel dazu bei, Wachstum und Rentabilität in einem Schlüsselsegment des Unternehmens sicherzustellen, um die langfristigen Ziele von TotalEnergie in Bezug auf die Wertschöpfung aus seiner Integrated Power-Strategie zu erreichen. Tätigkeiten:
• Täglich schriftliche Berichte an europäische Trading Power-Teams, einschließlich Front Desks, „Pricing & Risk Management-Teams und Senior Management sowie an die Pariser Zentrale, Tochtergesellschaften und Marktpartner.
• Erstellen, aktualisieren und halten Sie Präsentationen zu marktbezogenen Themen.
• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Automatisierung und Industrialisierung von Berichten, wenn möglich, mit Hilfe von Analysten, quantitativen Modellierern und IT-Teams.
• Überwachen Sie die Verfügbarkeit neuer Datenquellen und Tools, um die aktuelle Reichweite der Analysen des Teams zu erweitern.
• Extrahiert aussagekräftige Erkenntnisse aus europäischen Fundamentalmodellen und Fundamentaldaten in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Analysten (Erzeugung, Nachfrage, Flüsse, Wetterauswirkungen usw.) und trägt zur Marktbeobachtung der Marktstruktur in Bezug auf Unternehmen, Infrastruktur und Vorschriften bei.
• Unterstützen Sie Händler bei der Definition von Handelsstrategien.
• Führen Sie Gespräche mit Trading Desks und / oder Senior Management.
• Arbeiten Sie mit den anderen regionalen Analysten zusammen, um Cross-Commodity / Cross-Geography-Analysen und -Prognosen zu erstellen, mit quantitativen Analysten und Datenwissenschaftlern im Team, um fortschrittliche Analysetechniken zu nutzen
• Führen Sie Ad-hoc-Analysen und Projekte zur Unterstützung anderer Analysten, Händler und Führungskräfte durch. Kandidatenprofil: Startdatum: 01/10/2026
• Laufende Studien in Wirtschaft, Business oder Engineering.
• Kenntnis des europäischen Strom- und Emissionsmarktes, der Übertragungs- und Strömungsdynamik von Stromsystemen und/oder des Betriebsverständnisses.
• Hervorragende Fähigkeiten mit der Microsoft Office Suite (Power Point, Excel ...).
• Skilly in Python-Programmierung und Databricks sind willkommen.
• Gute analytische Fähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit, große Mengen an Informationen in einige wichtige Erkenntnisse umzuwandeln.
• Arbeitserfahrung in einer Handelsumgebung ist willkommen;
• Vertrautheit mit Visualisierungs-Frameworks (PowerBI/etc.) sind willkommen.
• Fließend Englisch (mündlich und schriftlich) – Französischkenntnisse und/oder andere Sprachen sind von Vorteil
• Die Position erfordert Autonomie, Objektivität, Innovation, um einfallsreich und gut organisiert zu sein;
• Der ideale Kandidat sollte in der Lage sein, komplexe Themen zu erklären und sie klar und prägnant darzustellen. Rechnungslegung
• Detaillierte Analyse, um aktuelle und zukünftige Treiber und Verhaltensweisen der europäischen Strom- und Emissionsmärkte zu identifizieren.
• Proaktive Beratung des europäischen Strom- und Emissionsmarktes gegenüber den zuständigen Stellen und dem Management
• Helfen Sie beim Aufbau und der Kommunikation einer globalen Sichtweise der Energiemärkte und verbessern Sie das Verständnis des Unternehmens für die Interaktionen der Energiemärkte
• Förderung der TGP-Handelsaktivitäten für Marktpartner und -partner durch Berichte, Treffen und Interventionen bei externen Treffen und Konferenzen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Contexte & Environnement: TotalEnergies Le gaz et l'énergie est le bras d'échange de TotalEnergies dans le domaine des énergies à faible intensité de carbone (principalement le gaz, le GNL et l'énergie). En tant que tel, elle opère dans une dynamique de marché en évolution rapide influencée par des facteurs internes et externes qui nécessitent une adaptation et une évolution constantes. Les incertitudes propres à l'environnement commercial (volatilité des prix, discordance de l'offre et de la demande) sont associées à celles qui viennent du secteur énergétique au sens large (politiques de changement climatique, changements dans la combinaison énergétique, développement de nouvelles sources d'énergie, etc.). Dans ce contexte, Trading contribue à assurer la croissance et la rentabilité à un segment clé de l'entreprise afin d'atteindre les objectifs à long terme de TotalEnergies en termes d'extraction de la valeur de sa stratégie de puissance intégrée. Activités :
• Fournir des rapports écrits quotidiens aux équipes d'European Trading Power, y compris les comptoirs, les équipes de «Pricing & Risk Management» et les cadres supérieurs, ainsi qu'au siège de Paris, aux filiales et aux partenaires du marché.
• Créer, mettre à jour et présenter des exposés sur des sujets liés au marché.
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'automatisation et de l'industrialisation des rapports lorsque c'est possible, avec l'aide d'analystes, de modélistes quantitatifs et d'équipes informatiques.
• Surveiller la disponibilité de nouvelles sources de données et d'outils pour élargir la portée actuelle de l'équipe.
• Extrait des modèles fondamentaux européens et des données fondamentales en collaboration avec d'autres analystes (génération, demande, flux, impact météorologique, etc.) et contribue à la veille du marché sur la structure du marché en termes d'entreprises, d'infrastructures et de réglementations.
• Soutenir les traders en définissant des stratégies de trading.
• Diriger les discussions avec les bureaux de négociation et/ou la haute direction.
• Collaborer avec les autres analystes régionaux à l'élaboration d'analyses et de prévisions transversales et transgéographiques, avec les analystes quantitatifs et les spécialistes des données au sein de l'équipe, afin de tirer parti des techniques d'analyse avancées
• Effectuer des analyses et des projets ponctuels à l'appui d'autres analystes, négociants et cadres supérieurs. Profil du candidat : Date de début : Le présent règlement entre en vigueur le jour suivant celui de sa publication au Journal officiel de l'Union européenne.
• Études en cours en économie, en affaires ou en génie.
• Connaissance du marché européen de l'électricité et des émissions, de la dynamique de l'expédition et des flux d'électricité et/ou de la compréhension des opérations.
• Excellentes compétences avec la suite Microsoft Office (Power Point, Excel...).
• Skilly dans la programmation Python et Databricks sont les bienvenus.
• Bonnes compétences analytiques, capacité de transformer de grandes quantités d'information en quelques idées clés.
• Une expérience de travail dans un environnement commercial est la bienvenue;
• La connaissance des cadres de visualisation (PowerBI/etc.) est la bienvenue.
• Fluent en anglais (oral et écrit) – la connaissance du français et/ou d'autres langues est un avantage
• La position exige l'autonomie, l'objectivité, l'innovation, pour être débrouillard et bien organisé;
• Le candidat idéal devrait pouvoir expliquer les questions complexes et les présenter de manière claire et concise. Responsabilités
• Fournir une analyse approfondie pour identifier les moteurs et comportements actuels et futurs des marchés européens de l'énergie et des émissions.
• Fournir une vue consultative proactive du marché européen de l'électricité et des émissions aux bureaux concernés et à la direction
• Aider à construire et à communiquer une vision globale des marchés de l'énergie, améliorer la compréhension des interactions des marchés de l'énergie
• Promouvoir les activités commerciales du PTF auprès des partenaires du marché et de leurs homologues au moyen de rapports, de réunions et d'interventions lors de réunions et de conférences externes

jobs.title: Quantitative LNG Analyst
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low-carbon energies. With more than 550 employees, TGP operates in Switzerland, the United States, Singapore, France, Germany and Spain. It evolves in fast-changing market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation. TGP is responsible for optimizing the purchase and sales portfolios of gas, electricity, CO ₂ emissions, dry bulk and LNG across global markets, in compliance with the Company’s trading guidelines. Join the Modelling and Analysis for Trading Strategies team (MATS) at the heart of TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) trading activities, where data, market fundamentals and quantitative modelling come together to support trading decisions . The Gas/LNG/Dry Modelling & Analysis team brings together market fundamentals experts and quantitative researchers who work closely with trading desks to understand market dynamics, anticipate price movements and identify opportunities. Through advanced analysis, modelling and forecasting, the team provides insights that help shape trading strategies and support strategic decision-making. Activities:
• You will be at the forefront of development of scalable, reusable, and intelligent frameworks that contribute to long-term P&L growth, ensuring they are built as maintainable, long-living, production-grade solutions.
• You will build extensible frameworks that evolve with business needs and are used across Gas&LNG trading desks.
• You will iteratively enhance these frameworks to support rapid feature delivery while minimizing technical debt and ensuring long-term maintainability.
• You will provide support to users (data scientists from MATS teams and traders) by leveraging your solid understanding of the tools developed in the team. You will facilitate their work by clearly presenting the features and guiding them to fully utilize the capabilities of the frameworks, ensuring they can maximize their potential.
• You will collaborate with key partner teams (e.g. Algo Strategies, Modelling & Analysis) to co-develop specialized tools, ensuring flexibility for researchers while maintaining core architectural standards.
• You will work on a variety of different problems related to energy and commodity markets and acquire business knowledge. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile:
• Strong technical or engineering background with a MSc in Comp. Science, Mathematics, Physics or Engineering
• At least 2 years experience on similar roles covering LNG and/or Natural Gas in a trading environment.
• A curious individual with a strong team spirit, always seeking to improve and innovate beyond the status quo.
• Strong ability to adapt to continuously changing environment.
• Programming skills (Python,SQL,), as well as familiarity with Optimization frameworks and statistical methods;
• Fluent in English (oral and written) – knowledge of French and/or other languages is an advantage;
• The position requires autonomy, objectivity, innovation, to be resourceful and well organised
• The ideal candidate should be able to explain complex issues and present them in a clear and concise manner. He/she should demonstrate openness when their ideas are challenged, and bring a proactive approach.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) è il braccio di trading di TotalEnergies nel campo delle energie a basso tenore di carbonio. Con oltre 550 dipendenti, TGP opera in Svizzera, Stati Uniti, Singapore, Francia, Germania e Spagna. Si evolve in dinamiche di mercato in rapida evoluzione influenzate da fattori interni ed esterni che richiedono un adattamento costante. TGP è responsabile dell’ottimizzazione dei portafogli di acquisto e vendita di gas, elettricità, emissioni di CO 2, rinfuse secche e LNG in tutti i mercati globali, nel rispetto delle linee guida di trading della Società. Unisciti al team Modelling and Analysis for Trading Strategies (MATS) nel cuore delle attività di trading TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP), dove i dati, i fondamenti di mercato e la modellazione quantitativa si uniscono per supportare le decisioni di trading . Il team Gas/LNG/Dry Modelling & Analysis riunisce esperti di marketing e ricercatori quantitativi che lavorano a stretto contatto con gli uffici di trading per comprendere le dinamiche di mercato, anticipare i movimenti dei prezzi e identificare le opportunità. Attraverso analisi avanzate, modellazione e previsione, il team fornisce informazioni che aiutano a modellare le strategie di trading e sostenere il processo decisionale strategico. Attività:
• Sarete all'avanguardia nello sviluppo di strutture scalabili, riutilizzabili e intelligenti che contribuiscono alla crescita P&L a lungo termine, garantendo che siano costruite come soluzioni manutenbili, di lunga durata, di qualità produttiva.
• Costruirete quadri estensibili che si evolvono con le esigenze aziendali e vengono utilizzati attraverso banchi di trading Gas&LNG.
• Sarà iterativamente migliorare questi quadri per sostenere la rapida consegna delle caratteristiche, riducendo al minimo il debito tecnico e garantendo la manutenbilità a lungo termine.
• Potrai fornire supporto agli utenti (dati scienziati di MATS team e trader) sfruttando la tua solida comprensione degli strumenti sviluppati nel team. Potrai facilitare il loro lavoro presentando chiaramente le caratteristiche e guidandoli a utilizzare pienamente le capacità dei quadri, assicurando che possano massimizzare il loro potenziale.
• Collaborerai con i team partner chiave (ad esempio Algo Strategies, Modelling & Analysis) per co-sviluppare strumenti specializzati, garantendo flessibilità per i ricercatori mantenendo al contempo gli standard architettonici fondamentali.
• Si lavorerà su una varietà di diversi problemi relativi ai mercati dell'energia e delle materie prime e acquisire conoscenze aziendali. Siamo impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze energetiche di una popolazione in crescita e ci impegniamo alla transizione energetica. La volatilità dei mercati del trading energetico richiede l'eccellenza nella gestione dei rischi e una cultura dell'innovazione. Stiamo abbracciando pienamente la rivoluzione digitale. I nostri popoli fioriscono in un ambiente che promuove competenze, spirito di imprenditorialità, agilità e una cultura mirata, generando opportunità sconfinate per imparare, crescere e raggiungere il successo collaborativo. Rafforzare le competenze del nostro popolo è un pilastro fondamentale della nostra cultura: formiamo il nostro popolo per garantire il loro sviluppo e ci impegniamo a incoraggiare la sicurezza in tutte le nostre azioni. Cerchiamo passione, ambizione e mentalità aperta. Mentre ci evolgiamo in un settore esigente che richiede di essere sempre al limite, coltiviamo un luogo di lavoro amichevole dove la nostra gente si sente bene, dove lo spirito di squadra e il rispetto guidano la nostra routine quotidiana, dove la diversità della nostra gente e le loro abilità creano un'esperienza nutriente per tutti noi. Profilo del candidato:
• Forte background tecnico o ingegneristico con un MSc in Comp. Scienza, Matematica, Fisica o Ingegneria
• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza su ruoli simili che coprono LNG e/o Gas naturale in un ambiente di trading.
• Un individuo curioso con un forte spirito di squadra, sempre alla ricerca di migliorare e innovare oltre lo status quo.
• Forte capacità di adattarsi all'ambiente in continua evoluzione.
• Capacità di programmazione (Python,SQL,), nonché familiarità con i framework di ottimizzazione e metodi statistici;
• Fluente in inglese (orale e scritto) – la conoscenza del francese e/o di altre lingue è un vantaggio;
• La posizione richiede l'autonomia, l'oggettività, l'innovazione, per essere intraprendente e ben organizzata
• Il candidato ideale dovrebbe essere in grado di spiegare problemi complessi e presentarli in modo chiaro e conciso. Egli dovrebbe dimostrare l'apertura quando le loro idee sono sfidate, e portare un approccio proattivo.

• A curious individual with a strong team spirit, always seeking to improve and innovate beyond the status quo.
• Strong ability to adapt to continuously changing environment.
• Programming skills (Python,SQL,), as well as familiarity with Optimization frameworks and statistical methods;
• Fluent in English (oral and written) – knowledge of French and/or other languages is an advantage;

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kontext & Umwelt: TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) ist der Handelszweig von TotalEnergies im Bereich kohlenstoffarmer Energien. Mit mehr als 550 Mitarbeitern ist TGP in der Schweiz, den USA, Singapur, Frankreich, Deutschland und Spanien tätig. Es entwickelt sich in einer sich schnell verändernden Marktdynamik, die von internen und externen Faktoren beeinflusst wird, die eine ständige Anpassung erfordern. TGP ist verantwortlich für die Optimierung der Einkaufs- und Verkaufsportfolios von Gas, Strom, CO2-Emissionen, Massengut und LNG auf den globalen Märkten in Übereinstimmung mit den Handelsrichtlinien des Unternehmens. Schließen Sie sich dem Team für Modellierung und Analyse von Handelsstrategien (MATS) an, das im Mittelpunkt der Handelsaktivitäten von TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) steht, wo Daten, Marktgrundlagen und quantitative Modellierung zusammenkommen, um Handelsentscheidungen zu unterstützen. Das Team für Gas / LNG / Trockenmodellierung und -analyse bringt Marktfundamentalexperten und quantitative Forscher zusammen, die eng mit Trading Desks zusammenarbeiten, um die Marktdynamik zu verstehen, Preisbewegungen zu antizipieren und Chancen zu identifizieren. Durch fortschrittliche Analyse, Modellierung und Prognose liefert das Team Erkenntnisse, die zur Gestaltung von Handelsstrategien und zur Unterstützung strategischer Entscheidungen beitragen. Tätigkeiten:
• Sie werden an der Spitze der Entwicklung von skalierbaren, wiederverwendbaren und intelligenten Frameworks stehen, die zum langfristigen Wachstum von P & L beitragen und sicherstellen, dass sie als wartbare, langlebige und produktionsfähige Lösungen aufgebaut sind.
• Sie erstellen erweiterbare Frameworks, die sich an die Geschäftsanforderungen anpassen und an Gas & LNG-Handelsschaltern verwendet werden.
• Sie werden diese Frameworks iterativ verbessern, um eine schnelle Funktionsbereitstellung zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig technische Schulden zu minimieren und langfristige Wartbarkeit zu gewährleisten.
• Sie unterstützen Benutzer (Datenwissenschaftler von MATS-Teams und Händlern), indem Sie Ihr solides Verständnis der im Team entwickelten Tools nutzen. Sie werden ihre Arbeit erleichtern, indem Sie die Funktionen klar präsentieren und sie anleiten, die Fähigkeiten der Frameworks vollständig zu nutzen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie ihr Potenzial maximieren können.
• Sie arbeiten mit wichtigen Partnerteams (z. B. Algo Strategies, Modelling & Analysis) zusammen, um gemeinsam spezialisierte Tools zu entwickeln und so Flexibilität für Forscher zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die wichtigsten architektonischen Standards beizubehalten.
• Sie werden an einer Vielzahl von verschiedenen Problemen im Zusammenhang mit Energie- und Rohstoffmärkten arbeiten und betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse erwerben. Wir verpflichten uns, den Energiebedarf einer wachsenden Bevölkerung zu decken, und wir engagieren uns für die Energiewende. Die Volatilität der Energiehandelsmärkte erfordert hervorragendes Risikomanagement und eine Innovationskultur. Wir nehmen die digitale Revolution voll und ganz auf. Unsere Mitarbeiter gedeihen in einem Umfeld, das Fachwissen, Unternehmergeist, Agilität und eine zielgerichtete Kultur fördert und grenzenlose Möglichkeiten zum Lernen, Wachsen und gemeinsamen Erfolg schafft. Die Stärkung der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeiter ist eine wichtige Säule unserer Kultur: Wir schulen unsere Mitarbeiter, um ihre Entwicklung zu gewährleisten, und wir verpflichten uns, die Sicherheit in all unseren Handlungen zu fördern. Wir suchen Leidenschaft, Ehrgeiz und Offenheit. Während wir uns in einer anspruchsvollen Branche entwickeln, die immer am Rande sein möchte, pflegen wir einen freundlichen Arbeitsplatz, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeiter gut fühlen, in dem Teamgeist und Respekt unseren Alltag leiten, in dem die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiter und ihre Fähigkeiten eine nährende Erfahrung für uns alle schaffen. Bewerberprofil:
• Starker technischer oder technischer Hintergrund mit einem MSc in Comp. Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Physik oder Ingenieurwissenschaften
• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in ähnlichen Rollen, die LNG und / oder Erdgas in einem Handelsumfeld abdecken.
• Eine neugierige Person mit einem starken Teamgeist, die immer versucht, sich zu verbessern und über den Status quo hinaus zu innovieren.
• Starke Fähigkeit, sich an die sich ständig verändernde Umwelt anzupassen.
• Programmierkenntnisse (Python,SQL) sowie Vertrautheit mit Optimierungs-Frameworks und statistischen Methoden;
• fließend Englisch (mündlich und schriftlich) – Kenntnisse von Französisch und/oder anderen Sprachen sind von Vorteil;
• Die Position erfordert Autonomie, Objektivität, Innovation, um einfallsreich und gut organisiert zu sein
• Der ideale Kandidat sollte in der Lage sein, komplexe Themen zu erklären und sie klar und prägnant darzustellen. Er / sie sollte Offenheit zeigen, wenn ihre Ideen in Frage gestellt werden, und einen proaktiven Ansatz einbringen.

Avec plus de 550 employés, TGP opère en Suisse, aux États-Unis, à Singapour, en France, en Allemagne et en Espagne. Elle évolue dans une dynamique de marché en évolution rapide influencée par des facteurs internes et externes qui nécessitent une adaptation constante. TGP est responsable d'optimiser les portefeuilles d'achat et de vente de gaz, d'électricité, de CO2, de vrac sec et de GNL sur les marchés mondiaux, conformément aux lignes directrices commerciales de la Société. Rejoignez l'équipe de modélisation et d'analyse pour les stratégies commerciales (MATS) au cœur des activités commerciales de TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP), où les données, les fondamentaux du marché et la modélisation quantitative se réunissent pour soutenir les décisions commerciales. L'équipe de modélisation et d'analyse du gaz, du GNL et du Dry réunit des experts des fondamentaux du marché et des chercheurs quantitatifs qui travaillent en étroite collaboration avec les bureaux de négociation pour comprendre la dynamique du marché, anticiper les mouvements de prix et identifier les possibilités. Grâce à une analyse, une modélisation et des prévisions avancées, l'équipe fournit des renseignements qui aident à façonner les stratégies de négociation et à appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques. Activités :
• Vous serez à l'avant-garde de l'élaboration de cadres évolutifs, réutilisables et intelligents qui contribuent à la croissance à long terme des P&L, en s'assurant qu'ils sont construits comme des solutions durables, durables et de qualité de production.
• Vous créerez des cadres extensibles qui évoluent en fonction des besoins des entreprises et qui sont utilisés dans les comptoirs de commerce de gaz et de GNL.
• Vous améliorerez ces cadres de façon itérative pour appuyer la prestation rapide des fonctionnalités tout en minimisant la dette technique et en assurant la viabilité à long terme.
• Vous fournirez un soutien aux utilisateurs (chercheurs de données des équipes MATS et des commerçants) en tirant parti de votre solide compréhension des outils développés dans l'équipe. Vous faciliterez leur travail en présentant clairement les caractéristiques et en les guidant pour utiliser pleinement les capacités des cadres, en s'assurant qu'ils peuvent maximiser leur potentiel.
• Vous collaborerez avec des équipes partenaires clés (p. ex. Algo Strategies, Modélisation & Analyse) afin de co-élaborer des outils spécialisés, assurant une flexibilité pour les chercheurs tout en maintenant les normes architecturales de base.
• Vous allez travailler sur une variété de différents problèmes liés aux marchés de l'énergie et des produits de base et acquérir des connaissances commerciales. Nous sommes déterminés à répondre aux besoins énergétiques d'une population croissante et nous sommes engagés dans la transition énergétique. La volatilité des marchés du commerce de l'énergie exige l'excellence dans la gestion des risques et une culture de l'innovation. Nous acceptons pleinement la révolution numérique. Nos gens prospèrent dans un environnement qui favorise l'expertise, l'esprit d'entreprise, l'agilité et une culture axée sur l'objectif, générant des possibilités illimitées d'apprendre, de grandir et de réussir en collaboration. Renforcer les compétences de notre peuple est un pilier clé de notre culture : nous formons notre peuple à assurer son développement et nous nous engageons à encourager la sécurité dans toutes nos actions. Nous recherchons passion, ambition et ouverture d'esprit. Alors que nous évoluons dans une industrie exigeante qui demande à être toujours à la pointe, nous cultivons un milieu de travail amical où nos gens se sentent bien, où l'esprit d'équipe et le respect guident notre routine quotidienne, où la diversité de nos gens et leurs compétences créent une expérience nourrissante pour nous tous. Profil du candidat :
• Forte expérience technique ou technique avec un MSc en Comp. Sciences, mathématiques, physique ou génie
• Au moins deux ans d'expérience sur des rôles similaires couvrant le GNL et/ou le gaz naturel dans un environnement commercial.
• Une personne curieuse, avec un esprit d'équipe fort, cherchant toujours à s'améliorer et à innover au-delà du statu quo.
• Forte capacité d'adaptation à un environnement en constante évolution.
• Compétences en programmation (Python,SQL), ainsi que connaissance des cadres d'optimisation et des méthodes statistiques;
• La connaissance du français et/ou d'autres langues est un avantage.
• La position exige l'autonomie, l'objectivité, l'innovation, pour être débrouillarde et bien organisée
• Le candidat idéal devrait pouvoir expliquer les questions complexes et les présenter de manière claire et concise. Il/elle devrait faire preuve d'ouverture lorsque ses idées sont contestées et adopter une approche proactive.

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Preferred start date: December 2026 Your next challenge starts in Geneva! Interested in European power markets, quantitative finance and the technologies transforming energy trading? Join our Structured Power Middle Office team in Geneva and gain exposure to the management of complex physical and financial power transactions, renewable energy portfolios and the risks associated with Europe's evolving electricity markets. Working at the intersection of trading, risk management and technology, you will contribute to meaningful projects combining portfolio analysis, automation, data analytics and artificial intelligence. TotalEnergies has developed a strong expertise in oil, biofuels, natural gas and electricity trading. Trading entities are based in Geneva, Paris, Dubai, Athens, Houston and Singapore. TotalEnergies installed its European trading hub across in Geneva, which now bring together very large teams around trading activities: TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T&S) and TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). Activities: Portfolio & Risk Analysis
• Analyze daily P&L, portfolio exposures and risk metrics across structured power portfolios.
• Investigate valuation movements, identify key market drivers and help resolve data or reporting discrepancies.
• Support risk monitoring and ad hoc analysis of power market fundamentals, asset performance and portfolio exposures. Data Analytics & Automation
• Develop analytical tools and automation solutions using Python, VBA and SQL.
• Contribute to the automation of recurring controls, reconciliations and reporting processes.
• Leverage Databricks to process large datasets and develop dashboards or internal applications using Streamlit and data visualization tools. Artificial Intelligence & Innovation
• Explore practical applications of Machine Learning and Generative AI in reporting, analytics, anomaly detection and information extraction.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen existing controls, improve operational efficiency and support decision-making through scalable technology solutions. European Power Markets
• Gain exposure to renewable energy transactions, Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), battery storage and flexibility assets.
• Develop an understanding of renewable integration, capture prices, imbalance risk and electricity price formation.
• Collaborate with Trading, Risk, Operations and Finance teams on cross-functional projects. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile: What we're looking for
• Currently pursuing a Master's degree or in the final year of studies in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or a related field.
• Strong programming skills in Python and advanced proficiency in Excel. Knowledge of VBA is highly desirable.
• Familiarity with SQL, Databricks, Streamlit and analytical libraries such as Pandas, NumPy or Plotly would be an advantage.
• Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Generative AI.
• An understanding of financial modelling, derivatives, valuation or risk metrics would be appreciated.
• Genuine interest in commodity trading and energy markets, particularly European power.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a rigorous, curious and detail-oriented approach.
• Ability to translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
• Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset and fluency in written and spoken English.
• Internship must be covered by a tripartite agreement.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Contesto & Ambiente: Data di inizio prevista: dicembre 2026 La tua prossima sfida inizia a Ginevra! Interessato ai mercati europei del potere, alla finanza quantitativa e alle tecnologie che trasformano il trading energetico? Unisciti al nostro team di uffici centrali a Ginevra e ottieni l'esposizione alla gestione di complesse transazioni di energia fisica e finanziaria, portafogli di energia rinnovabile e ai rischi associati ai mercati elettrici in evoluzione dell'Europa. Lavorando all'incrocio tra trading, risk management e tecnologia, contribuirai a progetti significativi che combinano analisi del portafoglio, automazione, analisi dei dati e intelligenza artificiale. TotalEnergies ha sviluppato una forte esperienza nel commercio di petrolio, biocarburanti, gas naturale e elettricità. Le entità di trading si trovano a Ginevra, Parigi, Dubai, Atene, Houston e Singapore. TotalEnergies ha installato il suo hub di trading europeo a Ginevra, che ora riunisce squadre molto grandi circa le attività di trading: TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T&S) e TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). Attività: Portfolio & Risk Analysis
• Analizzare la P&L quotidiana, le esposizioni di portafoglio e le metriche di rischio attraverso i portafogli di potenza strutturati.
• Indagare i movimenti di valutazione, identificare i driver chiave del mercato e aiutare a risolvere i dati o le discrepanze di report.
• Supporta il monitoraggio dei rischi e l'analisi ad hoc dei fondamenti del mercato del potere, delle prestazioni degli asset e delle esposizioni al portafoglio. Analisi dei dati e automazione
• Sviluppare strumenti analitici e soluzioni di automazione utilizzando Python, VBA e SQL.
• Contribuisci all'automazione dei controlli ricorrenti, delle conciliazioni e dei processi di reporting.
• Leva Databricks per elaborare grandi set di dati e sviluppare dashboard o applicazioni interne utilizzando strumenti di visualizzazione di dati e Streamlit. Intelligenza artificiale e innovazione
• Esplora applicazioni pratiche di Machine Learning e AI Generativo nel reporting, analisi, rilevamento di anomalia e estrazione di informazioni.
• Identificare le opportunità di rafforzare i controlli esistenti, migliorare l'efficienza operativa e supportare il processo decisionale attraverso soluzioni tecnologiche scalabili. Mercati europei di energia
• Ottieni l'esposizione a transazioni energetiche rinnovabili, accordi di acquisto di energia (PPAs), accumulazione della batteria e attività di flessibilità.
• Sviluppare una comprensione dell'integrazione rinnovabile, catturare i prezzi, il rischio di squilibrio e la formazione dei prezzi dell'elettricità.
• Collabora con i team Trading, Risk, Operazioni e Finanza su progetti interfunzionali. Siamo impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze energetiche di una popolazione in crescita e ci impegniamo alla transizione energetica. La volatilità dei mercati del trading energetico richiede l'eccellenza nella gestione dei rischi e una cultura dell'innovazione. Stiamo abbracciando pienamente la rivoluzione digitale. Le nostre persone fioriscono in un ambiente che promuove competenze, spirito di imprenditorialità, agilità e una cultura mirata, generando opportunità sconfinate per imparare, crescere e raggiungere il successo collaborativo. Rafforzare le competenze del nostro popolo è un pilastro fondamentale della nostra cultura: formiamo il nostro popolo per garantire il loro sviluppo e ci impegniamo a incoraggiare la sicurezza in tutte le nostre azioni. Cerchiamo passione, ambizione e mentalità aperta. Mentre ci evolgiamo in un settore esigente che richiede di essere sempre al limite, coltiviamo un luogo di lavoro amichevole dove la nostra gente si sente bene, dove lo spirito di squadra e il rispetto guidano la nostra routine quotidiana, dove la diversità della nostra gente e le loro abilità creano un'esperienza nutriente per tutti noi. Profilo del candidato: Cosa stiamo cercando
• Attualmente perseguire un Master o nell'ultimo anno di studi in Finanza Quantitativa, Ingegneria Finanziaria, Matematica Applicata, Statistica, Scienza dei dati, Scienza informatica, Ingegneria, Economia o un campo correlato.
• Forte capacità di programmazione in Python e competenza avanzata in Excel. La conoscenza di VBA è altamente auspicabile.
• La familiarità con SQL, Databricks, Streamlit e biblioteche analitiche come Pandas, NumPy o Plotly sarebbe un vantaggio.
• Forte interesse per l'intelligenza artificiale, l'apprendimento automatico e l'intelligenza genetica.
• Una comprensione della modellazione finanziaria, dei derivati, della valutazione o delle metriche di rischio sarebbe apprezzata.
• Interessi genuini nel commercio delle materie prime e nei mercati dell'energia, in particolare il potere europeo.
• Eccellente analitica e problem solving, con un approccio rigoroso, curioso e orientato al dettaglio.
• Capacità di tradurre le sfide aziendali in soluzioni tecniche pratiche.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, una mentalità collaborativa e fluenza in inglese scritto e parlato.
• Il tirocinio deve essere coperto da un accordo tripartito.

• Fähigkeit, geschäftliche Herausforderungen in praktische technische Lösungen umzusetzen.

jobs.title: Derivatives & Market Risk Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Take your first steps into energy trading Interested in derivatives, quantitative finance and global energy markets? Discover how trading portfolios are valued, monitored and analysed every day. About Us TotalEnergies is an integrated multi-energy company with expertise in oil and biofuels, natural gas, electricity and low-carbon energies. Our Trading & Shipping and Gas & Power activities connect international energy markets with trading teams and support functions. Our Geneva hub brings together specialists working across physical and financial energy markets. Our Culture Energy markets move quickly, and so do our teams. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, collaboration and initiative. As an intern, you will learn from experienced professionals, contribute to real projects and work in a diverse, international environment where continuous development and respect are central to how we work. Activities: Within TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping in Geneva, the Derivatives Middle Office team monitors the performance and market risks of trading portfolios. Working at the interface of Front Office, Finance and risk-control functions, the team analyses positions, valuations and market movements to provide accurate daily reporting and reliable indicators for decision-making. This internship offers hands-on exposure to derivatives, commodity markets and quantitative risk analysis in a fast-moving international trading environment. Your Responsibilities
• Support daily monitoring of trading positions, portfolio exposures and risk indicators, including Value at Risk (VaR), stress tests and sensitivity analysis.
• Assist with the calculation, control and explanation of daily profit and loss (PnL), including analysis of market movements and other key drivers.
• Help verify the consistency of transaction data, pricing inputs, market curves and mark-to-market valuations against available information.
• Contribute to quantitative analysis and the development, testing and improvement of risk monitoring and reporting tools, working with Middle Office, traders and IT teams.
• Prepare clear analyses and documentation to communicate findings to the team and support reliable reporting. Candidate Profile:
• Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering or another strongly quantitative field.
• Strong mathematical and analytical skills, with an interest in derivatives pricing, financial modelling and stochastic processes.
• Strong Python programming skills and proficiency in Excel; knowledge of SQL and VBA is an advantage.
• Understanding of financial derivatives, such as futures, swaps and options; an interest in commodity and energy markets is valued.
• Rigorous, curious and proactive, with the ability to analyse complex information, communicate clearly and work collaboratively under deadlines.
• Fluent English; French is an advantage.
• A tri-partite agreement is mandatory

descriptionByLocale.it:
Contesto & Ambiente: Prendere i primi passi nel trading energetico Interessato a derivati, finanza quantitativa e mercati energetici globali? Scopri come i portafogli di trading vengono valutati, monitorati e analizzati ogni giorno. TotalEnergies è un'azienda multi-energia integrata con competenze in petrolio e biocarburanti, gas naturale, energia elettrica e basse emissioni di carbonio. Le nostre attività di Trading & Shipping e Gas & Power collegano i mercati internazionali dell'energia con i team di trading e le funzioni di supporto. Il nostro hub di Ginevra riunisce specialisti che lavorano sui mercati dell'energia fisica e finanziaria. I nostri mercati dell'energia culturale si muovono rapidamente, e così fanno le nostre squadre. Apprezziamo la curiosità, il pensiero analitico, la collaborazione e l'iniziativa. Come tirocinante, imparerai da professionisti esperti, contribuirai a progetti reali e lavorerai in un ambiente diverso e internazionale dove lo sviluppo e il rispetto continui sono centrali per come lavoriamo. Attività: All'interno di TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping di Ginevra, il team Derivatives Middle Office monitora le prestazioni e i rischi di mercato dei portafogli di trading. Lavorando nell'interfaccia delle funzioni di Front Office, Finance e risk-control, il team analizza posizioni, valutazioni e movimenti di mercato per fornire un'accurata segnalazione quotidiana e indicatori affidabili per il processo decisionale. Questo stage offre un'esposizione pratica a derivati, mercati delle materie prime e analisi dei rischi quantitativi in un ambiente di trading internazionale in rapida evoluzione. Le tue responsabilità
• Supporta il monitoraggio giornaliero delle posizioni di trading, delle esposizioni di portafoglio e degli indicatori di rischio, tra cui il valore al rischio (VaR), i test di stress e l'analisi della sensibilità.
• Assistere con il calcolo, il controllo e la spiegazione del profitto e della perdita quotidiana (PnL), compresa l'analisi dei movimenti di mercato e di altri driver chiave.
• Aiuta a verificare la consistenza dei dati delle transazioni, degli input dei prezzi, delle curve di mercato e delle valutazioni di mark-to-market contro le informazioni disponibili.
• Contribuisci all'analisi quantitativa e allo sviluppo, alla sperimentazione e al miglioramento degli strumenti di monitoraggio e reporting dei rischi, lavorando con Middle Office, trader e team IT.
• Preparare analisi e documentazione chiare per comunicare i risultati al team e sostenere report affidabili. Profilo del candidato:
• Attualmente perseguire un Master in Finanza Quantitativa, Ingegneria Finanziaria, Matematica, Ingegneria o un altro campo fortemente quantitativo.
• Forte capacità matematiche e analitiche, con un interesse per i prezzi derivati, la modellazione finanziaria e i processi stocastici.
• Forte capacità di programmazione Python e competenza in Excel; la conoscenza di SQL e VBA è un vantaggio.
• Comprensione di derivati finanziari, come futures, swaps e opzioni; si valuta un interesse per i mercati delle materie prime e dell'energia.
• Rigoroso, curioso e proattivo, con la capacità di analizzare informazioni complesse, comunicare con chiarezza e lavorare in collaborazione con le scadenze.
• Inglese fluente; francese è un vantaggio.
• Un accordo tripartito è obbligatorio

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: 6-month internship Start date: December 2026 Trading & Shipping (T&S) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies for crude oil, refined products, biofuels and paper derivatives. With around 1,000 employees, T&S operates from Geneva, Houston, Singapore, Dubai, Athens and Paris, ensuring the daily supply of refineries and distribution networks worldwide. In energy markets, T&S creates value through fair value assessment of flows, sourcing the best products for customers, and managing operational, financial, regulatory and HSE risks. As logistics and safety professionals, teams operate across the entire energy supply chain in fast-moving markets shaped by geopolitical and economic factors, requiring constant adaptation. We are seeking a high-potential, analytically driven engineering-minded Procurement Analyst Intern to join our team . This internship offers deep exposure to real-life commodity trading operations , hands-on experience in procurement , data-driven decision-making , and supplier management within a high-pressure and fast trading environment . The successful candidate will support strategic sourcing initiatives and take ownership of structuring, analysing and improving complex operational problems, directly contributing to cost efficiency, risk control, and supplier performance. As a Procurement Analyst Intern within T&S Trading Operations, you will join a 30-member Operations Technical Services (OTS) team supporting trading activities and actively preserving PnL in day-to-day operations. Your responsibilities will focus on procurement activities for service providers such as inspection companies, superintendents, and additive suppliers. You will help generate concrete, measurable business impact by optimising procurement processes, managing tenders and Request for Proposals (RFP), improving cost transparency and contract coverage, and designing, prototyping and (where relevant) deploying data-driven or automated solutions, while fostering strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. What makes this internship distinctive This internship is designed for engineers who want to see the real-world impact of their analytical and technical skills in a trading environment. High-performing interns are given increasing ownership, exposure and responsibility throughout the internship, based strictly on results and impact. Activities:
• Collect, analyse, structure and interpret procurement datasets to support fast, fact-based operational decisions.
• Identify service providers without framework agreements or with insufficient contractual, KYC or compliance coverage.
• Support the preparation and execution of RFPs and tenders, including problem structuring with stakeholders, timeline management and data consolidation.
• Analyse supplier proposals (pricing logic, compliance, service levels, performance indicators) to challenge market practices and optimise value creation.
• Monitor supplier performance and adherence to contractual commitments.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure data consistency, reliability and traceability across tools.
• Conduct cost analysis, benchmarking and quantitative market intelligence exercises.
• Oversee service provider onboarding to ensure alignment with HSE, contracts, pricing structures and internal standards.
• Work closely with Finance, Operations, Trading Desks, IT and Legal teams in a front-office-adjacent environment.
• Participate in analytical and data-backed price negotiations with service providers.
• Represent TotalEnergies professionally and uphold the company’s image in all interactions.
• Proactively propose ideas to automate, simplify or redesign workflows and improve procurement tools. Ownership, intellectual curiosity and a builder mindset are essential in this role. Objectives
• Gain hands-on experience in high-impact service procurement within a global trading organisation.
• Improve contractual coverage, cost transparency and quantified cost & risk control.
• Enhance the usability, automation level and technical robustness of internal procurement tools.
• Contribute to the development of clear, structured and scalable procurement frameworks.
• Streamline service provider onboarding while maintaining TotalEnergies’ operational and HSE standards.
• Build a strong hybrid analytical/business skillset relevant for trading and trading operations environments. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Candidate Profile:
• Final year of a Master’s degree in Engineering or quantitative disciplines (Industrial, Mechanical, Civil, Energy, Data, IT, Applied Maths, Operations Research). Candidates from top engineering schools (EPFL, Centrale, Mines, etc.) are particularly encouraged to apply.
• Strong analytical and problem-structuring mindset; you naturally think in systems, models and data.
• Demonstrated interest in commodities markets, trading or trading operations.
• Prior experience in data analysis, coding, optimisation, operations, logistics or quantitative modelling.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel and data visualisation tools (Power BI).
• Proficiency in Python with the ability to prototype, automate and, when relevant, deploy solutions into real operational tools. Exposure to AI / LLM tools applied to business problems is a strong plus.
• Fluent in English and French.
• Fast learner, hands-on, results-oriented, comfortable operating under time pressure.
• Strong communication skills and ability to interact with senior and operational stakeholders.
• Internship must be covered by a tripartite agreement. The internship takes place within the fast-moving environment of international commodity trading, where decisions are time-sensitive and directly linked to financial outcomes.
